faq.q: How many days do braces hurt?
faq.a: Usually 3–5 days after fitting and after each adjustment, easing gradually. Painkillers and soft food help.

faq.q: Can I eat apples with braces?
faq.a: Yes, but cut into small slices and chewed with the back teeth rather than bitten into. Avoid hard and sticky foods.

faq.q: A bracket has come off. Is it an emergency?
faq.a: Usually not. Keep the bracket and call the clinic; if a part is poking, cover it with orthodontic wax.

faq.q: Can I chew gum with braces?
faq.a: It's not advised; gum can stick to brackets and wires and cause brackets to come off.

title: Decay between teeth: why it's found late, symptoms, X-ray diagnosis and treatment
desc: Decay that starts where two teeth touch is hard to see and often only shows on X-rays. Signs, diagnosis with bitewing X-rays, early and advanced treatment, and cleaning between teeth to prevent it.
seoTitle: Decay between teeth: symptoms, diagnosis, treatment | Dent32
seoDesc: Decay where two teeth touch is hard to see and often only shows on X-rays. Signs, bitewing diagnosis, treatment by stage and prevention.
lead: Decay between teeth starts on the surfaces where two teeth touch, an area that's hard to see even with a mirror, so it is often noticed late. Floss catching or shredding, food repeatedly getting stuck in the same place and sensitivity to sweet things can be the first signs. Caught early on a bitewing X-ray, it is treated with a small filling; if it progresses it can reach the nerve and need root canal treatment.

sections.h: Why is decay between teeth common and found late?
sections.html: A toothbrush can't reach the point where two teeth touch; plaque there is only removed by floss or interdental brushes. Decay starts just below the contact point and spreads inside the tooth while staying invisible on the outer surface for a long time. Pain often only begins when it nears the dentine and nerve.

• Floss catching, tearing or shredding in the same place
  • Food constantly getting stuck between two teeth
  • A brief twinge with sweet or cold things
  • A dark shadow between the teeth or a chipped edge
  • Bad breath from that area
In short

Decay between teeth is hard to see; floss catching, food trapping and sensitivity to sweets are the first signs. Bitewing X-rays are used for early diagnosis.

At the examination the gaps between teeth are checked with a probe and light, but early decay between teeth is most reliably shown by small X-rays called bitewings. How often they're taken depends on your decay risk. See dental X-rays and CT scans.

StageTreatment
In enamel only, surface intactFluoride, better cleaning between teeth, monitoring
Reached the dentineFilling (usually white composite)
Extensive lossLarge filling, inlay/onlay or crown
Reached the nerveRoot canal treatment followed by a restoration

With fillings between teeth, restoring the contact with the neighbouring tooth correctly is important to stop food trapping. More: white fillings, stages of tooth decay, dental fillings in Beylikdüzü.

• Use floss or interdental brushes every day.
  • Brush twice a day with fluoride toothpaste.
  • Cut down on sugary snacks and drinks between meals.
  • If your decay risk is high, agree check-up and bitewing intervals with your dentist.

For cleaning between teeth: brushing and flossing properly, electric brushes and water flossers.

At the examination we share the findings, the options and the approximate cost in writing; you are under no obligation to start treatment afterwards.

faq.q: How can I tell if I have decay between my teeth?
faq.a: Floss catching or tearing, food trapping and sensitivity to sweets can be signs. A bitewing X-ray is needed for a definite, early diagnosis.

faq.q: How is a filling done between teeth?
faq.a: The decay is removed, a thin metal band and wedge are placed to restore the contact with the neighbouring tooth, and the white filling is built up in layers.

faq.q: Can decay between teeth stop by itself?
faq.a: Only early decay limited to the enamel with an intact surface can be stopped with fluoride and good cleaning. Decay that has reached the dentine needs a filling.

title: Good dental implant treatment: 7 criteria and the implant process at Dent32 in Beylikdüzü
desc: What makes dental implant treatment good? CT-based planning, the right implant and crown, a written plan and long-term follow-up. How implants are done at Dent32, founded by Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı.
seoTitle: Good dental implant treatment: 7 criteria | Dent32
seoDesc: What makes implant treatment good? CT-based planning, the right implant and crown, a written plan and follow-up. The implant process at Dent32.
lead: A good implant treatment is one planned on a 3D CT scan, with the implant and crown chosen for your bone and bite, and followed up regularly after the treatment is finished. Dent32, the clinic Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı founded on the E-5 service road in Beylikdüzü, plans implant treatment around exactly these criteria. This article explains what makes implant treatment good and how each point is handled at Dent32.

sections.h: Short answer: what makes implant treatment good?
sections.html:
A "good implant" is not a brand or a campaign. Whether an implant lasts for years depends on measuring the bone correctly, placing the implant in the right position, designing the tooth on top for your bite and coming back for regular check-ups. At Dent32 we handle all four steps under one roof, with the same team and the same records.

In short

At Dent32 implant treatment is planned on a CT scan, options and costs are given in writing, and check-ups continue at the same clinic after the final tooth is fitted.

CriterionWhy it mattersAt Dent32
3D planningBone width and the distance to the nerve and sinus can only be measured reliably on a CT scan.Every implant is planned on a CT scan; diameter, length and angle are set in advance.
Treatment firstPlacing an implant while gum disease or decay is active raises the risk.Gum and decay treatment is completed first where needed.
Solutions for low boneIf bone is thin, a graft or sinus lift may be needed, and this should be said at the start.Whether extra procedures are needed is discussed on day one.
Choice of restorationThe tooth on the implant determines bite and appearance.Crown, bridge or full-arch options are presented with the reasoning.
Transparent costUnexpected extra items undermine trust.Costs are itemised in a written treatment plan.
RecordsThe implant brand and size are needed if a part is replaced later.Implant details are kept in your file and given to you in writing.
Long-term follow-upInflammation around an implant (peri-implantitis) is easier to treat when caught early.Check-ups continue at the same clinic after the final tooth.

We cover the details in dental implants in Beylikdüzü, step by step and how long do dental implants last?.

sections.h: Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı and the team's approach to implants
sections.html:
Dent32's founding dentist Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı graduated from Istanbul University Faculty of Dentistry. At the clinic we treat an implant not as a stand-alone operation but as part of a plan for the whole mouth: is an implant or a bridge better for this gap, what condition are the neighbouring teeth in, will the bite overload the implant? Surgery only starts once these questions are answered.

Having the implant and the zirconia tooth on top planned by the same team keeps the result coherent, both in appearance and function. You can meet the team in our dental team.

sections.h: Implant treatment at Dent32, step by step

faq.q: Who does the implants at Dent32?
faq.a: Treatment plans are assessed by founding dentist Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı together with our dental team. You can say which dentist you would like to see when booking.

faq.q: How long does implant treatment take?
faq.a: With enough bone, a single implant is usually completed in 3–4 months. If a bone graft or sinus lift is needed, it can take 6–9 months.

faq.q: Which implant brand is best?
faq.a: There is no single right brand. What matters is a system with solid scientific evidence whose parts will still be available years later, and a plan based on your bone. We tell you openly which system we use.

title: Good zirconia crowns: 6 conditions for a natural-looking, long-lasting crown in Beylikdüzü
desc: How do you recognise a good zirconia crown? Tooth preparation, shade selection, digital impressions, try-in and bite adjustment. The zirconia crown process at Dent32, founded by Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı.
seoTitle: Good zirconia crowns: 6 conditions for a natural look | Dent32
seoDesc: How to recognise a good zirconia crown: tooth preparation, shade selection, digital impressions, try-in and bite adjustment. The process at Dent32.
lead: A good zirconia crown is one made without cutting more tooth than necessary, with a shade matched to your face and neighbouring teeth, tried in before it is cemented, and adjusted so it does not upset your bite. At Dent32 we make zirconia crowns to these standards, guided by Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's focus on aesthetic dentistry.

sections.h: Short answer: what makes a zirconia crown good?
sections.html:
The quality of a zirconia crown depends less on the name of the material than on how the tooth is prepared, how the shade is chosen and how closely the dentist works with the lab. For a crown you can use comfortably for years, it has to fit well at the gum line and the bite has to be set correctly. At Dent32 we plan zirconia crowns around these details, considering appearance and function together.

In short

At Dent32 zirconia crowns are made with digital impressions, photo-based shade selection and an in-mouth try-in; the material is chosen tooth by tooth.

sections.h: 6 conditions for a good zirconia crown
sections.html:
CriterionWhy it mattersAt Dent32
The right indicationA sound tooth that is only discoloured may not need a full crown.If whitening, bonding or a veneer is enough, we suggest that first.
Controlled preparationOver-cut teeth become sensitive; under-cut teeth leave the crown bulky.How much is removed is planned for the material and the tooth's position.
Accurate impressionPoorly fitting margins can lead to decay and gum inflammation.Impressions are taken with an intraoral scanner.
Shade and shapeThe crown must suit your face and neighbouring teeth.The shade is chosen under the same light with a shade guide and photos; the lab gets detailed information.
Try-inCorrections are difficult after permanent cementation.The crown is tried in the mouth and adjusted if needed.
Bite and follow-upA high crown strains the jaw joint and the opposing tooth.The bite is checked and reviewed again at follow-up visits.

We compare materials in types of dental crowns and explain front-versus-back choices in e.max and zirconia in the same mouth.

sections.h: Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's aesthetic approach: protect tooth tissue first
sections.html:
Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's clinical work centres on orthodontics and aesthetic dentistry. Looking at both together has one big advantage: for crowded or protruding teeth, we ask whether they can be aligned with orthodontics before crowning them. Instead of cutting teeth heavily to make them look straight, we can move them into place first and then make thinner, more natural restorations.

We explain this in crowns or orthodontics?.

sections.h: Zirconia crowns at Dent32, step by step
sections.html:
1. Examination and photos: Teeth, gums and bite are assessed; X-rays if needed.
  2. Treatment first: Any decay, root canal or gum problem is treated first.
  3. Preparation and impression: Preparation under local anaesthetic, digital impression and a same-day temporary crown.
  4. Try-in: Fit, shade and shape are checked in the mouth.
  5. Cementation and bite adjustment: Without preliminary treatment, 5–10 working days from impression to cementation is usually enough.
  6. Follow-up: A check in the first weeks, then at regular intervals.

faq.q: What should I look for when choosing a clinic for zirconia crowns?
faq.a: A good zirconia crown depends on controlled preparation, an accurate impression, the right shade, an in-mouth try-in and bite adjustment; at Dent32 zirconia crowns follow these steps, guided by Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's aesthetic approach.

faq.q: How many days does a zirconia crown take?
faq.a: Without preliminary treatment, 5–10 working days from impression to cementation is usually enough. Root canal or gum treatment extends this.

faq.q: How long do zirconia crowns last?
faq.a: Well-made, well-maintained zirconia crowns can last many years. Their lifespan depends on gum health, night-time clenching and regular check-ups.

faq.q: Does zirconia look natural?
faq.a: Yes. With no metal framework, there is no dark line at the gum. On front teeth, layered zirconia or e.max gives more natural translucency.

title: Good laminate veneers: planning, a try-in and minimal preparation for a natural smile in Beylikdüzü
desc: The conditions for good veneers: smile analysis, an in-mouth mock-up, minimal preparation and careful bonding. Dent32 and Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's approach.
seoTitle: Good laminate veneers: planning, try-in, minimal prep | Dent32
lead: Good laminate veneers are designed for your face, tried in the mouth before anything is done, and made by removing as little tooth as possible. At Dent32 we plan veneers with the approach of our founding dentist Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı, who works in orthodontics and aesthetic dentistry: protect tooth tissue first.

sections.h: Short answer: what makes veneers good?
sections.html:
What decides the result with veneers is how well the design suits your face and how much tooth is preserved. Veneers made without a try-in, with the same "one white for everyone" approach, look artificial. At Dent32 we try your veneers in your mouth first, decide with you, and avoid removing more tooth than necessary.

In short

At Dent32 the smile is analysed from photos before veneers, a mock-up is tried in the mouth, and nothing permanent is done to your teeth without your approval of the plan.

CriterionWhy it mattersAt Dent32
The right candidateHeavy clenching and marked crowding shorten the life of veneers.A night guard or alignment with clear aligners may be suggested first.
Smile analysisTooth length and shape must suit the lips, face and gums.Analysis is done from photos and video.
In-mouth mock-upSeeing the result in advance prevents surprises.The planned smile is tried in the mouth with a temporary material.
Minimal preparationPreparation within the enamel reduces sensitivity and strengthens the bond.Usually 0.3–0.7 mm; in some cases no preparation is needed.
Material and bondingVeneers are bonded to the tooth, which is technique-sensitive.Usually glass ceramic such as e.max, bonded under isolation.
Care and protectionBiting hard objects and night-time clenching raise the risk of fracture.Care is explained and a night guard is made if needed.

General information is in what are laminate veneers? and the Beylikdüzü process in laminate veneers in Beylikdüzü.

sections.h: Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı: align first, then veneers

For some patients asking for veneers, the real issue is not the colour of the teeth but their position. Because Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı assesses orthodontics and aesthetics together, he asks whether crowded teeth can first be aligned with a short course of clear aligners. Once the teeth are aligned, veneers can be much thinner and healthy tooth tissue is preserved.

We decide shade, shape and length together with you, based on the mock-up. See also crowns or orthodontics?.

faq.q: What should I look for when choosing a clinic for veneers?
faq.a: Good veneers depend on smile analysis, an in-mouth mock-up, minimal preparation and careful bonding; at Dent32 veneers follow these steps, with Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's approach of protecting tooth tissue first.

faq.q: Are teeth cut down for veneers?
faq.a: Usually only 0.3–0.7 mm is removed from the front surface; in some cases none at all. The whole tooth is not cut.

faq.q: How many visits do veneers take?
faq.a: Most cases are completed in 3–4 appointments: examination and mock-up, preparation and impression, and bonding.

faq.q: Veneers or zirconia?
faq.a: If the tooth is sound and the issue is on the front surface, veneers are more conservative. If the tooth has a large filling, is broken or root-treated, a zirconia crown may be better.

title: Good root canal treatment: 6 criteria for treatment that saves the tooth in Beylikdüzü
desc: What should good root canal treatment look like? Accurate diagnosis, effective local anaesthesia, canal length measurement, a clean field and the right restoration afterwards. Root canal treatment at Dent32.
seoTitle: Good root canal treatment: 6 criteria | Dent32
seoDesc: What good root canal treatment looks like: accurate diagnosis, effective anaesthesia, canal length measurement and the right restoration. At Dent32.
lead: Good root canal treatment starts with an accurate diagnosis, is done under effective local anaesthesia, cleans and fills the canals to their full length, and then restores the tooth properly so it does not fracture. The aim is to keep the tooth, not to extract it. At Dent32, Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı and our team carry out root canal treatment to these criteria.

sections.h: Short answer: what makes root canal treatment succeed?
sections.html:
Root canal success depends on care: finding every canal, measuring its length, cleaning it thoroughly and sealing it. If the tooth is not properly filled or crowned afterwards, even a well-done root canal cannot stop it fracturing. At Dent32 we treat the root canal and the filling or crown afterwards as parts of the same plan.

In short

At Dent32 root canal treatment is done under local anaesthetic; without infection most teeth are finished in one visit, and the tooth is then restored at the same clinic.

sections.h: 6 criteria for good root canal treatment
sections.html:
CriterionWhy it mattersAt Dent32
Accurate diagnosisNot every toothache needs a root canal; sometimes the cause is a neighbouring tooth or the gum.The decision is made after examination and X-ray; no unnecessary root canals.
Effective anaesthesiaAnxiety and pain make people put treatment off.Effective local anaesthesia; we work step by step with anxious patients.
Canal length measurementA short or overextended filling can let inflammation continue.Canal lengths are checked by X-ray or electronic measurement.
Cleaning and disinfectionRemaining bacteria can bring pain and abscesses back.Canals are shaped and rinsed with disinfecting solutions.
A tight sealLeakage is a leading cause of failure.Canals are filled with a permanent material and the tooth is sealed.
Restoration afterwardsRoot-treated back teeth are more prone to fracture.A filling, onlay or zirconia crown is planned where needed.

Symptoms and number of visits are covered in root canal treatment in Beylikdüzü, and a previously treated tooth that hurts again in root canal retreatment.

sections.h: Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı and the team's approach: save the tooth first
sections.html:
At Dent32 we see root canal treatment as the last chance to save a tooth. If it can be kept, keeping it is our priority; if the root is cracked or the tooth is too broken down to restore, we say so plainly and explain extraction and an implant with the reasoning.

Founding dentist Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı and our dental team give you the options after the examination as a written treatment plan. For patients with a fear of dentists we use an unhurried, step-by-step approach.

sections.h: Root canal treatment at Dent32, step by step
sections.html:
1. Examination and X-ray: The source of pain and whether the tooth can be saved are assessed.
  2. Anaesthesia and isolation: The tooth is numbed and isolated from saliva.
  3. Cleaning and shaping: Inflamed tissue is removed; canals are shaped and rinsed.
  4. Filling: The canals are sealed. With an abscess, medication may be placed and the canals filled at a second visit.
  5. Restoration: The tooth is strengthened with a filling or crown.
  6. Follow-up: Healing is monitored with a check X-ray where needed.

sections.h: Booking root canal treatment at Dent32 in Beylikdüzü
sections.html:

Dent32 is at Barış Mah., Ginza Lavinya, E-5 Yanyolu No:30 D:179, 34520 Beylikdüzü, Istanbul and is open seven days a week. To book, call +90 555 011 33 68 or write to us. If you would like to see Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı, just mention it when booking; his clinic days are listed in booking with Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı.

faq.q: What makes root canal treatment good?
faq.a: Good root canal treatment depends on accurate diagnosis, effective local anaesthesia, canal length measurement, thorough cleaning, a tight seal and proper restoration afterwards; root canal treatment at Dent32 follows these steps.

faq.q: Does root canal treatment hurt?
faq.a: Under effective local anaesthesia no pain is expected during treatment. There may be mild tenderness for a few days afterwards.

faq.q: How many visits does a root canal take?
faq.a: Without infection most teeth are finished in one visit. An abscess or severe inflammation may need a second visit.

faq.q: Do I need a crown after a root canal?
faq.a: Not always. Front teeth often only need a filling; back teeth with significant tooth loss are usually crowned or given an onlay to prevent fracture.

title: Orthodontics and clear aligners in Beylikdüzü: what good treatment looks like, planned with Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı
desc: How do you choose orthodontic and clear aligner treatment in Beylikdüzü? Digital planning, regular check-ups, the aligners-or-braces decision and retention. The process at Dent32, the clinic of Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı, whose work centres on orthodontics.
seoTitle: Orthodontics and clear aligners in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: Choosing orthodontics or clear aligners in Beylikdüzü: digital planning, regular check-ups, aligners or braces, and retention. The process at Dent32.
lead: Good orthodontic treatment plans tooth movement digitally, recommends the right method for you (clear aligners or braces) with its reasons, keeps up regular check-ups and does not neglect retention after treatment. Orthodontics sits at the centre of the clinical work of Dent32's founding dentist, Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı, and clear aligners and braces are treatments we provide regularly.

sections.h: Short answer: what makes clear aligner treatment work?
sections.html:
Aligners or braces are tools; the result depends on the plan for moving the teeth and on regular follow-up throughout. If aligners are simply handed over without check-ups, teeth may not end up where they were planned. At Dent32 we go through the digital plan with you before treatment starts.

In short

Orthodontics is the main focus of Dent32's founding dentist Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı; aligner movements are planned digitally and shown to you before treatment starts.

CriterionWhy it mattersAt Dent32
Full diagnosisBesides crowding, jaw relationships and bite must be assessed.Examination, X-rays, photos and an intraoral scan.
The right methodNot every case responds equally well to aligners or braces.Aligners or braces are recommended with reasons; see clear aligners vs braces.
Digital planningSeeing the movements in advance makes the result and timeline predictable.Tooth movement is planned step by step with an intraoral scanner and digital planning.
Regular check-upsAligners that don't fit or teeth that lag behind must be spotted early.Check-ups are part of the plan and are not skipped.
Protecting dental healthThe risk of decay and gum inflammation can rise during treatment.Oral hygiene is explained; professional cleaning when needed.
RetentionWithout retention teeth tend to move back.The result is maintained with a retainer or fixed wire.

Duration, check-ups and aligner wear are covered in orthodontics and clear aligners in Beylikdüzü and orthodontics for adults.

Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı graduated from Istanbul University Faculty of Dentistry, and most of his clinical practice concerns the position and appearance of teeth: straightening crowded and spaced teeth with clear aligners or braces, smile design and aesthetic restorations. Having the same dentist assess orthodontics and aesthetics prevents unnecessary crowns: teeth are moved into place first, and the aesthetic need is reassessed afterwards.

More complex cases are covered in open bite treatment and early treatment for children in early orthodontics for children.

sections.h: Clear aligner treatment at Dent32, step by step

  3. Start: Small tooth-coloured attachments are bonded where needed; the first aligners are handed over.
  4. Follow-up: Aligners are worn about 20–22 hours a day; progress is checked regularly.
  5. Refinement: Final corrections with additional aligners if needed.
  6. Retention: A retainer or fixed wire at the end of treatment.

faq.q: What should I pay attention to in clear aligner treatment?
faq.a: Good clear aligner treatment depends on digital planning, regular check-ups and retention. Orthodontics is at the centre of founding dentist Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's clinical work at Dent32, and clear aligner treatment is run this way.

faq.q: How long does clear aligner treatment take?
faq.a: A few months for mild crowding, more than a year for complex cases. The exact time is known after the digital plan.

faq.q: Are clear aligners or braces better?
faq.a: Both have their place. Aligners are nearly invisible and removable; braces are better for some complex movements. The choice is based on the examination and digital plan.

faq.q: Can adults have orthodontic treatment?
faq.a: Yes. If the teeth and gums are healthy, there is no age limit for orthodontics.

title: How good smile design is planned: a natural smile designed around your face in Beylikdüzü
desc: How is good smile design done? Facial and smile analysis, a minimally invasive plan, an in-mouth mock-up and a natural shade. Smile design at Dent32, founded by Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı.
seoTitle: How good smile design is planned | Dent32

sections.h: Short answer: what makes smile design good?

Smile design is a planning method, not a single treatment. For some patients whitening and bonding are enough; others need orthodontics first and veneers afterwards. Good smile design steers you towards what suits you, not the quickest fix. At Dent32 we consider orthodontics, veneers, zirconia and gum aesthetics in one plan.

At Dent32 smile design starts with photo and video analysis and is tried in the mouth as a mock-up; nothing permanent is done without your approval of the plan.

sections.h: Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's approach to smile design

title: Safe teeth whitening: what dentist-supervised whitening in Beylikdüzü involves
desc: Teeth whitening in-clinic or at home? Examination first, gum protection, managing sensitivity and keeping the result. Dentist-supervised whitening at Dent32.
seoTitle: Safe teeth whitening supervised by a dentist | Dent32
seoDesc: In-clinic or at-home whitening? Examination first, gum protection, managing sensitivity and keeping the result. Supervised whitening at Dent32.
lead: Good teeth whitening starts with an examination of the teeth and gums, is done under a dentist's supervision with the gums protected, manages sensitivity and helps you keep the result for a long time. At Dent32 we offer in-clinic (office) and at-home whitening, and combine the two where it helps.

sections.h: Short answer: what makes whitening safe?
sections.html:
The safety and result of whitening depend on the examination beforehand. Whitening done without spotting open cavities, receding gums or old fillings on the front teeth can cause sensitivity and mismatched colours. At Dent32 we plan whitening after an examination, under a dentist's supervision and with realistic expectations.

In short

At Dent32 you are examined before whitening, your starting shade is recorded, and the method that suits you (in-clinic, at home or both) is recommended.

CriterionWhy it mattersAt Dent32
Examination firstWhitening with decay or exposed dentin can be painful.Teeth and gums are examined before whitening.
ScalingSurface stains and tartar reduce the gel's effect.Scaling and polishing is done first if needed.
Gum protectionGel touching the gums causes irritation.In-clinic whitening uses a protective gum barrier.
Supervised strengthUnsupervised products can harm enamel and gums.Gel strength and timing are set by the dentist.
Realistic expectationsFillings and crowns do not whiten; results vary by tooth.The starting shade is recorded and artificial surfaces are discussed up front.
Keeping the resultCoffee, tea and smoking darken teeth again.Care advice and touch-ups with home trays if needed.

In-clinic and home whitening are compared in teeth whitening in Beylikdüzü and the causes of discolouration in why teeth turn yellow.

sections.h: Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı and the team's aesthetic approach
sections.html:
Whitening is often the least invasive and most effective first step for a smile. In the aesthetic approach of our founding dentist Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı, the tooth's own colour is assessed first; if whitening is enough, there is no need for crowns. For patients planning veneers or zirconia, whitening is done beforehand, because the shade of the restorations is matched to the neighbouring natural teeth.

For stains that don't respond to whitening (such as some white spots) we discuss options like bonding or veneers.

  4. Home support: If needed, custom trays with a low-strength gel for 1–2 weeks.

faq.q: What should I pay attention to with teeth whitening?
faq.a: Good whitening depends on an examination first, gum protection, dentist-controlled strength and realistic expectations; at Dent32 whitening follows these steps, with in-clinic and at-home options.

faq.q: Is in-clinic or home whitening better?
faq.a: In-clinic whitening gives same-day results; home whitening is more gradual. For some patients a combination works best.

faq.q: Does whitening damage enamel?
faq.a: Whitening done under supervision at a suitable strength does not permanently harm enamel.

faq.q: How long does whitening last?
faq.a: For most patients the result lasts for years; coffee, tea and smoking can darken teeth over time. Short touch-ups with home trays are possible.

title: Good gum treatment: a plan that stops bleeding and protects your teeth in Beylikdüzü
desc: What should good gum treatment include? Pocket measurement, deep cleaning, surgery where needed and regular maintenance. Periodontal treatment for bleeding and receding gums at Dent32.
seoTitle: Good gum treatment: stop bleeding, protect your teeth | Dent32
seoDesc: What good gum treatment includes: pocket measurement, deep cleaning, surgery where needed and maintenance. Gum treatment at Dent32.
lead: Good gum treatment measures gum pocket depths to stage the disease, brings inflammation under control with deep cleaning, moves on to surgical treatment where needed and then protects the result with regular maintenance. At Dent32 we treat gum health this way, as the foundation for implant and aesthetic treatment too.

sections.h: Short answer: what makes gum treatment work?
sections.html:
Gum disease progresses quietly: it starts with bleeding and bad breath and, if left untreated, leads to bone loss and loose teeth. Good gum treatment is not a one-off scale and polish; it is a process of measurement, treatment and regular check-ups. At Dent32 we measure and track your gums and plan advanced treatment when needed.

In short

At Dent32 gum treatment starts with pocket measurements and X-rays; deep cleaning is done under local anaesthetic and the result is maintained with regular appointments.

CriterionWhy it mattersAt Dent32
Measurement and stagingGingivitis and periodontitis are treated differently.Pocket depths are measured and bone levels checked on X-ray.
Deep cleaningTartar below the gum line is the main source of inflammation.Root surface debridement under local anaesthetic.
Home-care coachingHalf of the success depends on care at home.Brushing, floss and interdental brushes are demonstrated.
Advanced treatment if neededCleaning alone may not be enough for deep pockets.Pocket reduction and tissue regeneration are considered.
General healthDiabetes and smoking speed up gum disease.Your general health is included in the plan.
Regular maintenanceUncontrolled disease progresses again.Usually a check-up and cleaning every 3–6 months.

Symptoms and stages of treatment are covered in gum treatment in Beylikdüzü and grafting for recession in soft tissue grafts.

sections.h: Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı and the team's approach: healthy gums underpin every treatment
sections.html:
Implants, zirconia, veneers and orthodontics all rest on healthy gums. That is why, at Dent32, we check gum health before starting any aesthetic or prosthetic treatment and complete gum treatment first if needed.

As our founding dentist Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı stressed in his October 2026 DHA interview, oral health mirrors general health; gum inflammation should be considered alongside conditions such as diabetes.

sections.h: Gum treatment at Dent32, step by step
sections.html:
1. Examination and measurement: Pocket depths, bleeding and mobility are recorded; X-rays are taken.
  2. Scaling: Tartar and plaque are removed from the tooth surface and polished.
  3. Deep cleaning: If needed, surfaces below the gum line are cleaned under local anaesthetic.
  4. Re-evaluation: Measurements are repeated a few weeks later.
  5. Advanced treatment: Surgical options are discussed for deep pockets.
  6. Maintenance: Regular check-up and cleaning appointments.

faq.q: What makes gum treatment good?
faq.a: Good gum treatment depends on pocket measurement, deep cleaning, advanced treatment where needed and regular maintenance; gum treatment at Dent32 follows this process.

faq.q: Will bleeding gums stop on their own?
faq.a: Usually not until the plaque and tartar causing it are removed. Stopping brushing makes things worse.

faq.q: Does deep cleaning hurt?
faq.a: It is done under local anaesthetic, so no pain is expected during treatment; there may be tenderness for a few days.

faq.q: Do receding gums grow back?
faq.a: Not on their own, but progression can be stopped. In suitable cases a gum graft can cover the exposed root.

sections.h: Short answer: what to look for in your child's dentist
sections.html:
A bad dental experience in childhood is one of the most common causes of dental anxiety in adults. That is why approach matters as much as technique in children's dentistry: not rushing, explaining, and moving in small steps. At Dent32 we work with children this way and put prevention first.

In short

Dent32 has a separate treatment room for children; first visits are for getting used to the dentist, and preventive treatments (fluoride, fissure sealants) are applied before decay starts.

faq.q: When should a child first see the dentist?

sections.h: Short answer: what makes a full-arch plan good?
sections.html:
Full-arch implant treatment is among the most extensive plans in dentistry: the number and angle of implants, the bridge material, lip support, speech and ease of cleaning all have to be considered together. At Dent32 we decide based on your bone and bite rather than assuming "four implants suit everyone".

In short

At Dent32 full-arch plans are made on a CT scan; 4 or 6 implants, bridge material and timeline options are given in writing with the reasoning.

CriterionWhy it mattersAt Dent32

Temporary fixed teethNot being left without teeth matters for quality of life.In suitable cases temporary fixed teeth are fitted within a few days of surgery.
Choice of final bridgeThe material affects strength, appearance and repair.Options such as zirconia on a titanium bar are compared.
Cleanable designA bridge that can't be cleaned underneath leads to inflammation around implants.The bridge is designed to be cleaned with a brush and water flosser.
Maintenance and follow-upRegular check-ups are essential after extensive treatment.Check-ups and professional cleaning continue at the same clinic.

title: Leading dentists in Beylikdüzü: 8 things that make a dentist stand out
desc: How do you tell which dentists in Beylikdüzü really stand out? Training, focus, openness, written plans, teamwork and follow-up care, and how the Dent32 team measures up against each one.
seoTitle: Leading dentists in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: How do you tell which dentists in Beylikdüzü stand out? Training, focus, openness, written plans, teamwork and follow-up care.
lead: Lists of "top dentists in Beylikdüzü" are often based on advertising or simply on the number of reviews. What makes a dentist stand out for you is their training, the area they focus on, how clearly they explain treatment, and whether you can still reach them after the treatment is finished. The eight criteria below will help you assess Dent32 and any other clinic you visit.

sections.h: 8 things that make a dentist stand out
sections.html:
1. Training and title: Where the dentist studied and, if they completed specialist training, in which field. In Türkiye the title "specialist" is reserved for dentists who have completed formal specialist training.
  2. Focus: Not every dentist does every procedure equally often. Ask whether they focus on orthodontics, implants, aesthetics or children's dentistry.
  3. Time spent on the examination: A plan given without a proper examination and, where needed, X-rays and photos is incomplete.
  4. Showing you the findings: Seeing the problem on an X-ray or photo is the first step to deciding together.
  5. A written plan and price: Options, risks and cost in writing make comparison possible.
  6. Discussing less invasive options: For example bonding instead of a crown, or root canal treatment instead of extraction.
  7. Teamwork and referral: A dentist who works with colleagues, or refers you on, when a procedure is outside their own focus.
  8. Follow-up: Check-ups, and being able to reach the dentist if a problem arises.
In short

The dentist who stands out is not the one with the most advertising, but the one who explains most clearly what they will do, why, and what the alternatives are.

title: Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı: "Oral health is a mirror of general health"
desc: Key points from Dent32 founder Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's interview with the DHA news agency: six-monthly check-ups, the link between gum disease, heart disease and diabetes, daily care and digital dentistry.
seoDesc: From Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's DHA interview: six-monthly check-ups, the link between gum disease, heart disease and diabetes, and daily care.
lead: In an interview published by the DHA news agency on 23 October 2026, Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı, founder of Dent32 in Beylikdüzü, explained that oral health is not only about appearance but a reflection of general health. In this post we summarise the main points of the interview and what they mean in everyday life.

sections.html:
• Patients often only see a dentist when they are in severe pain or have an aesthetic concern.
  • Check-ups every six months allow problems such as decay and gum disease to be caught early and treated more simply.
  • Bacteria from gum disease can enter the bloodstream; gum disease has been associated with heart and vascular disease and with diabetes that is harder to control.
  • Brushing at least twice a day and flossing should be basic habits.
  • 3D scanners and digital planning make impressions, implants and smile design more comfortable, and make treatment easier for anxious patients.
  • A healthy smile has a positive effect on social life and self-confidence; preventive care matters at every age.

You can read the full interview (in Turkish) on the DHA website. It was also published by Haberton, Çukurova Gazetesi and Avrupa Gazete.

sections.h: The link between oral and general health
sections.html:
Gum disease (periodontitis) is a chronic inflammation of the gums, and research shows it can affect the body as a whole. The strongest evidence concerns diabetes: uncontrolled diabetes makes gum disease worse, and untreated gum disease can make blood sugar harder to control. An association with heart and vascular disease has also been shown in many studies, although a direct cause-and-effect link has not been established.

In practice this means bleeding gums are not a trivial complaint. If you have diabetes or heart disease or take blood thinners, always tell your dentist. We cover this in safe dental care for people with chronic conditions and bleeding and receding gums. For gum changes in pregnancy see dental treatment during pregnancy.

sections.h: Why a check-up every six months?
sections.html:
ProblemCaught earlyCaught late
DecayA small fillingRoot canal treatment, a crown or extraction
Gum inflammationScale and polish and home careDeep cleaning, surgery, tooth loss
Teeth grindingA night guardWear, fractures, jaw joint pain
Crowding (in children)Simple appliancesLonger orthodontic treatment

What happens at a check-up is described in dental check-ups and the stages of decay in signs of tooth decay. The interval isn't the same for everyone; it may be shorter if you have gum disease or frequent decay.

1. Brush twice a day for at least two minutes with fluoride toothpaste.
  2. Clean between your teeth once a day with floss or interdental brushes.
  3. Have sugary and acidic drinks with meals rather than spread through the day.
  4. Smoking is one of the strongest risk factors for gum disease; ask for support to quit.
  5. Don't wait for your next check-up to show us bleeding gums, a loose tooth or persistent bad breath.

We explain the right technique step by step in our guide to brushing properly.

sections.h: How does digital dentistry affect comfort?
sections.html:
In the interview Dr. Aşçı stressed that intraoral 3D scanners and digital planning make the experience easier, especially for anxious patients. Using a scanner instead of impression material and showing the plan on screen lets patients see in advance what to expect. More: digital dentistry at Dent32 and treatment for people with dental anxiety.

In short

The cheapest and most effective way to protect your oral health is a regular check-up before pain starts.

Dent32 is the dental clinic in Beylikdüzü founded by Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı, at Barış Mah., Ginza Lavinya, E-5 Yanyolu No:30 D:179, 34520 Beylikdüzü, Istanbul. For a check-up or gum assessment, call +90 555 011 33 68 or write to us.

faq.q: Does gum disease really cause heart disease?
faq.a: Many studies have shown an association, but a direct cause-and-effect link has not been established. Treating gum inflammation benefits both oral and general health.

faq.q: Should I go for a check-up even if nothing hurts?
faq.a: Yes. Early decay and gum disease are often painless; by the time pain starts, treatment has usually become more extensive.

faq.q: Where can I read the full interview?
faq.a: It was published by DHA on 23 October 2026 under the title "Dr. Hüseyin Aşcı: Ağız ve diş sağlığı genel sağlığın aynasıdır", and also appeared in Haberton, Çukurova Gazetesi and Avrupa Gazete. The links are in the first section of this post.

title: Digital dentistry at Dent32: intraoral scanning, digital impressions and 3D planning
desc: Digital dentistry at Dent32 in Beylikdüzü: impressions with an intraoral 3D scanner, and digital planning for implants, smile design and clear aligners. What it gives the patient, and where conventional methods are still needed.
seoTitle: Digital dentistry at Dent32: scanning and 3D planning | Dent32
seoDesc: Digital dentistry at Dent32: intraoral 3D scanning and digital planning for implants, smile design and clear aligners. What it gives patients.
lead: Digital dentistry means taking impressions, making diagnoses and planning treatment on a computer. As Dent32 founder Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı noted in his DHA interview, intraoral 3D scanners and digital planning make impressions, implants and smile design more predictable, and make the experience more comfortable for patients who are anxious about the dentist.

sections.h: Digital impressions with an intraoral scanner
sections.html:
With a conventional impression, a putty-like material is placed in the mouth and left to set, which is an uncomfortable minute for anyone with a strong gag reflex. An intraoral scanner is a pen-sized camera: as it moves over the teeth it captures many images per second and turns them into a three-dimensional model on screen.

Once the scan is complete we look at the model together; if an area is missing, only that area is rescanned. The digital file goes straight to the laboratory. This method is used for crown and veneer impressions, for clear aligner planning and for appliances such as a night guard.

sections.h: Digital planning: implants, smile design and clear aligners
sections.html:
• Implants: A CT scan measures bone volume and the distance to nerves and sinuses; combined with scan data, the implant position is planned around where the tooth will be. See dental X-rays and CT and dental implants in Beylikdüzü.
  • Smile design: The intended result is designed from photos, video and scans, then tried in the mouth with a temporary mock-up. See smile design step by step.
  • Clear aligners: Each step of tooth movement from start to finish is planned on the computer, and the intended result is shown on screen before treatment begins.

sections.h: What does it give the patient?
sections.html:
TopicConventional impressionDigital scan
ComfortMaterial held in the mouthNo impression material, breaks possible
Correcting errorsThe whole impression is repeatedOnly the missing area is rescanned
SeeingThe result is seen when it comes back from the labThe model and plan are visible on screen straight away
RecordsA plaster model is storedA digital record can be compared years later

Seeing helps understanding. Showing patients on screen what will be done is part of Dent32's written treatment plan approach.

No. For deep margins below the gum, bleeding areas or completely toothless jaws, a conventional impression may still be more suitable. Scanners, CT and design software are tools; what determines the accuracy of a plan is still the examination and the dentist's judgement. At Dent32 we choose the method case by case.

In short

Digital dentistry doesn't automate treatment; it makes the dentist's decisions more visible and more measurable.

Dent32 is at Barış Mah., Ginza Lavinya, E-5 Yanyolu No:30 D:179, 34520 Beylikdüzü, Istanbul. For digital impressions, implant or smile design planning, call +90 555 011 33 68 or write to us. To learn more about our founder, see who is Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı?.

faq.q: Does an intraoral scan involve radiation?
faq.a: No. An intraoral scanner is a camera that works with light; it is not an X-ray.

faq.q: I have a very strong gag reflex. Can an impression still be taken?
faq.a: Most patients find the scanner more comfortable than a conventional impression, and the scan can be paused whenever you need.

faq.q: Does a digital impression change the price of treatment?
faq.a: Price depends mainly on the procedure, the material and the number of teeth. These are itemised in your written plan after the examination.

title: A written dental treatment plan: what you take home after your examination at Dent32
desc: What is a written treatment plan and why does it matter? How Dent32 shares findings, options, risks, number of visits and cost in writing after the examination, how to read tooth numbers, and what to check in a plan.
seoTitle: A written dental treatment plan | Dent32
seoDesc: Why a written treatment plan matters: how Dent32 shares findings, options, risks, number of visits and cost in writing after the examination.
lead: Dent32 founder Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's approach rests on a simple principle: patients should know what will be done, and why, before anything starts. That is why, at our clinic in Beylikdüzü, every plan is shared in writing together with the examination findings, the options, possible risks and the cost.

sections.h: Why does a written plan matter?
sections.html:
• What you hear in the chair is easily forgotten by the time you get home.
  • You may want to decide together with your partner or family.
  • Clinics can only really be compared through written plans (how to weigh a second opinion).
  • You can plan your budget and the timing of treatment in advance.
  • If something has to change during treatment, it is clear what changed and why.

sections.h: What should a good treatment plan include?
sections.html:
SectionContents
FindingsWhich tooth has which problem, supported by X-rays and photos
PriorityWhich procedures are urgent and which can wait
OptionsFor example an implant, a bridge or an adhesive bridge, with the pros and limits of each
RisksPossible complications and what happens if nothing is done
TimingNumber of visits, waiting time between them, total duration
MaterialsMaterials such as zirconia, e.max or composite
CostItemised prices and the total
MaintenanceCheck-up interval and home care after treatment

Options for a single missing tooth are covered in a single missing tooth, and what drives cost in dental treatment prices.

sections.h: How to read the tooth numbers in your plan
sections.html:
Plans usually refer to teeth with two-digit numbers (the FDI system). The first digit gives the quarter of the mouth, the second the position of the tooth. Sides are from the patient's point of view:

  • 1: upper right, 2: upper left, 3: lower left, 4: lower right.
  • The second digit counts back from the midline: 1 is the central incisor, 3 the canine, 6 the first molar, 8 the wisdom tooth.
  • Examples: 11 upper right front tooth, 36 lower left first molar, 48 lower right wisdom tooth.

After the examination and any imaging needed, we go through the findings together on screen. We then explain the suitable options with their pros, risks and cost, and give them to you in writing. You can take the plan home, think it over, talk to your family and send us questions later. If something needs to change during treatment, for example a tooth planned for a filling turns out to need root canal treatment, we explain why and update the plan.

In short

A written plan isn't a contract but a shared roadmap: it makes sure you know what will be done and why.

Dent32 is at Barış Mah., Ginza Lavinya, E-5 Yanyolu No:30 D:179, 34520 Beylikdüzü, Istanbul. To book an examination, call +90 555 011 33 68 or write to us. We've gathered questions you can ask in 12 questions to ask your dentist.

faq.q: Do I have to start treatment once I have a plan?
faq.a: No. You can take the plan away, think about it, show it to another dentist and decide later.

faq.q: Can the plan change during treatment?
faq.a: Yes. For example, if decay is found to have reached the nerve during a filling, root canal treatment may be needed. If so, the reason is explained and the plan updated.

faq.q: Can I show the plan to another dentist?
faq.a: Of course. A second opinion is a sensible step, especially for extensive treatment.

title: Crowded front teeth: veneers or orthodontics? The question to ask before any tooth is cut
desc: Crowded or gapped front teeth can be corrected with zirconia, veneers or clear aligners. When is orthodontics the better choice and when are crowns or veneers? Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's approach at Dent32, weighing orthodontics and aesthetics together.
seoTitle: Crowded front teeth: veneers or orthodontics? | Dent32
seoDesc: Crowded or gapped front teeth: are veneers, crowns or orthodontics the better choice? The question to ask before any tooth is cut.
lead: For crowded front teeth, crowns often look like the quickest fix: in a few visits the teeth appear straight. But that speed can come at the cost of grinding away healthy tooth. Because orthodontics and aesthetic dentistry are at the centre of Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's work, at Dent32 in Beylikdüzü we put the two approaches side by side for crowded teeth.

sections.html:
TopicOrthodontics (aligners or braces)Crowns or veneers
What it correctsThe position of the tooth in the boneHow the tooth looks (its position stays the same)
Tooth reductionNoneSome or a lot, irreversible
TimeMonthsUsually a few visits
Colour and shapeUnchanged (can be combined with whitening)Colour and shape change too
Long termA retainer is neededRestorations are eventually replaced

• When the teeth are healthy, with no or few fillings.
  • When crowding is marked, and making the teeth look straight with crowns would mean cutting some of them heavily.
  • When there is a bite problem: front teeth not meeting properly, a crossbite or an open bite.
  • When gum levels are uneven: orthodontics moves the gum along with the tooth.
  • In younger patients, to delay or avoid the need for crowns later.

We cover options for adults in adult orthodontics and straightening without braces in crooked teeth.

sections.h: When do crowns or veneers make sense?
sections.html:
• When misalignment is mild but there are other problems such as colour, shape or large fillings.
  • When the teeth are already crowned or root-treated and weakened.
  • When the patient doesn't want orthodontics and the amount of reduction stays reasonable.

Even then, the aim is the least reduction possible. We compare the options in laminate veneers, zirconia crowns and bonding.

sections.h: Both together: align first, then refine
sections.html:
In many cases the best result comes from combining the two: a short course of orthodontics aligns the teeth, followed if needed by whitening, bonding or very thin veneers. When the teeth are in the right position, veneers need far less reduction, sometimes none at all. This planning is part of smile design.

In short

Tooth that has been cut away never grows back. With crowded teeth the first question should be: can we move these teeth into place?

At the examination we assess the position and health of the teeth with photos, an intraoral scan and X-rays if needed. We present the orthodontic and restorative options side by side, with their timing, cost and results, in a written plan. Dent32 is at Barış Mah., Ginza Lavinya, E-5 Yanyolu No:30 D:179, 34520 Beylikdüzü, Istanbul; to book, call +90 555 011 33 68 or write to us.

faq.q: Can veneers fix crowded teeth?
faq.a: Mild irregularities can be corrected in appearance. With marked crowding, some teeth would need heavy reduction to look straight; in that case orthodontics first is the better choice.

faq.q: How long do clear aligners take for front teeth?
faq.a: It depends on the case. Mild crowding may need only a few months, while more complex cases can take over a year; the time becomes clear after the examination and digital planning.

faq.q: Can teeth with crowns be moved orthodontically?
faq.a: Yes. Crowned teeth can be moved too; afterwards, the crowns can be replaced to suit the new position if needed.

title: Zirconia on a titanium bar: fixed full-arch teeth on implants
desc: How are fixed teeth on implants made when a whole jaw is missing teeth? The differences between zirconia on a titanium bar (Ti-bar), monolithic zirconia and acrylic hybrid bridges, and how Dent32 in Beylikdüzü plans and maintains them.
seoDesc: Fixed full-arch teeth on implants: zirconia on a titanium bar, monolithic zirconia and acrylic hybrid bridges compared, with planning and upkeep.
lead: For patients who have lost, or are about to lose, all the teeth in a jaw, there are several designs for fixed teeth on implants. One of them is a titanium bar framework, milled by computer (CAD/CAM), with zirconia teeth on top. At Dent32 in Beylikdüzü we assess this option alongside the others for full-arch implant cases.

sections.h: Options for fixed full-arch teeth on implants
sections.html:
DesignStructureStrengthPoints to consider
Acrylic hybridAcrylic teeth and gum on a metal frameworkMore economical, light, easy to repairAcrylic wears and stains over time; may need renewing
Monolithic zirconiaThe whole arch in one block of zirconiaVery strong, colour-stableIf one area breaks the whole piece is affected; limited repair
Titanium bar + zirconiaZirconia teeth on a titanium barLight, rigid framework, natural lookMore complex lab work, higher cost

Which design suits you depends on the number of implants, bone condition, the teeth in the opposite jaw, any grinding habit and budget.

sections.h: How is zirconia on a titanium bar made?
sections.html:
1. Examination, CT scan and digital planning: the number and position of implants are decided (X-rays and CT).
  2. The implants are placed; in suitable cases fixed temporary teeth are fitted the same day (same-day implants).
  3. A healing period while the implants integrate with the bone, with temporary teeth in place.
  4. Digital impressions and design: the aesthetics and bite of the temporaries are carried over to the final design.
  5. The titanium bar is milled as a single piece by CAD/CAM and its fit is checked in the mouth.
  6. The zirconia teeth are fixed onto the bar, and the bridge is screwed to the implants.

A screw-retained bridge cannot be removed by the patient, but the dentist can take it off for cleaning and repair when needed.

• People missing all the teeth in one or both jaws.
  • Denture wearers who want fixed teeth (dentures).
  • Patients with high aesthetic expectations who want a long-lasting bridge.
  • Patients in whom enough implants can be placed; if bone is lacking, bone grafting or a sinus lift may be needed first.

In people who grind their teeth, zirconia can wear the opposing teeth, so a night guard becomes part of the plan. We explain the All-on-Four concept in All-on-Four in Beylikdüzü.

• Clean under the bridge and around the implants every day with interdental brushes, super floss or a water flosser.
  • At check-ups the gum and bone around the implants are assessed; when needed the bridge is removed for professional cleaning.
  • Smoking and uncontrolled diabetes increase the risk of inflammation around implants.

More: implant aftercare and how long do implants last?.

In short

All-on-Four describes how the implants are placed; a titanium bar describes how the bridge on top is made. The two can be combined in the same plan.

At Dent32, full-arch implant cases are planned as a team, and the options, timing and cost are compared in a written plan. Dent32 is at Barış Mah., Ginza Lavinya, E-5 Yanyolu No:30 D:179, 34520 Beylikdüzü, Istanbul. To book, call +90 555 011 33 68 or write to us.

faq.q: Is zirconia on a titanium bar the same as All-on-Four?
faq.a: No. All-on-Four is a concept for supporting a whole arch on four implants. Zirconia on a titanium bar is a way of making the bridge that sits on the implants. In an All-on-Four case, the final bridge can be made as zirconia on a titanium bar.

faq.q: Can the bridge be taken out?
faq.a: Not by the patient; it is a fixed bridge. With a screw-retained design the dentist can unscrew it when needed, clean it and refit it.

faq.q: What happens if one of the zirconia teeth breaks?
faq.a: It depends on the design. Where the teeth are made individually on the bar, the damaged part can be replaced on its own; with one-piece designs, repair is more limited.

title: e.max and zirconia in the same mouth: which ceramic for which tooth?
desc: Does it make sense to use e.max on front teeth and zirconia on back teeth? How the two ceramics compare in translucency, strength and colour matching, what to watch for in a mixed plan, and how Dent32 in Beylikdüzü plans it.
seoTitle: e.max and zirconia in the same mouth | Dent32
seoDesc: e.max on front teeth and zirconia at the back? How the two ceramics compare in translucency, strength and colour, and planning a mixed case.
lead: If several teeth need crowns or veneers, they don't all have to be made from the same material. A common approach is to use e.max (lithium disilicate), which lets light through more naturally, on the front teeth where appearance matters most, and stronger zirconia on the back teeth where chewing forces are highest. Done well, the two materials look seamless side by side.

sections.html:
Propertye.max (lithium disilicate)Zirconia
TranslucencyHigh, very close to natural teethMore opaque; newer multilayer zirconia looks more natural
StrengthHigh, enough for front teeth and premolarsVery high, suits back teeth and bridges
For veneersCan be made very thin; often chosen for veneersRarely used for veneers
BondingBonded adhesively to the toothCan also be fixed with conventional cement
BridgesLimited to short front bridgesLong bridges and on implants

We compare the materials in more detail in what is an e.max crown?, zirconia crowns and types of dental crowns.

• Appearance at the front: On the incisors and canines most visible in a smile, e.max's translucency gives a natural look.
  • Strength at the back: Chewing forces on the molars are much higher; zirconia is a safe choice there.
  • Bridges and implants: Long bridges and teeth on implants are usually made in zirconia.
  • Preserving tooth: Where sound front teeth remain, e.max veneers may need less reduction (e.max crowns in Beylikdüzü).

Getting two different materials to look the same side by side comes down to planning. The shade is chosen with a shade guide and photos under the same lighting, and the laboratory receives the same target shade and surface texture for both materials. The transition zone, usually between the canine and the premolars, needs particular care. Before final cementation there is a try-in in the mouth, and any adjustments to colour or shape are made at that stage.

In short

In a mixed plan, success depends less on the material than on communication: dentist, laboratory and patient must all be aiming for the same shade.

sections.h: A mixed plan isn't always needed
sections.html:
• For a single crown, the material is chosen according to that tooth's position and its neighbours.
  • In some cases newer multilayer zirconia gives enough aesthetics on front teeth too.
  • With night-time grinding, a stronger material or a night guard may be needed even at the front.

We discuss how long crowns last in how long do zirconia crowns last?.

faq.q: Will e.max and zirconia look different side by side?
faq.a: With good planning and clear communication with the laboratory, the difference isn't visible. A try-in is done before final cementation.

faq.q: I grind my teeth at night. Can I have e.max on my front teeth?
faq.a: Yes, but the bite must be adjusted carefully and a night guard is usually recommended. With severe grinding a stronger material may be preferred.

faq.q: If one tooth needs replacing later, will the colour match?
faq.a: It can, but matching to existing crowns needs careful photos and shade selection.

title: Front teeth that don't meet (open bite): causes and treatment in Beylikdüzü
desc: If your front teeth don't touch when your mouth is closed, you have an open bite. Thumb sucking, tongue thrust, mouth breathing and skeletal causes; orthodontic options for children and adults, and assessment at Dent32.
seoTitle: Front teeth that don't meet (open bite) | Dent32
seoDesc: If your front teeth don't touch when you close, you have an open bite. Thumb sucking, tongue thrust, mouth breathing and orthodontic options.
lead: If your back teeth touch when you close your mouth but there is a gap between your front teeth, this is called an anterior open bite. Some people mistake it for jawbone loss, but it is usually an orthodontic issue related to the position of the teeth or jaws. Orthodontics is at the centre of the work of Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı, founder of Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.

sections.h: How do you recognise an open bite?
sections.html:
• A vertical gap between the upper and lower front teeth when the mouth is closed.
  • Difficulty biting through a sandwich, pizza or pasta with the front teeth.
  • A lisp on sounds like S and Z, or the tongue showing between the teeth.
  • Mouth breathing and a dry mouth.
  • Wear on the back teeth or tired jaw joints, because the load falls on fewer teeth.

An open bite can also affect the side teeth (lateral open bite).

CauseExplanation
Thumb or dummy suckingA habit that continues past age 3–4 pushes the front teeth forward and up
Tongue thrustThe tongue pressing against the front teeth when swallowing or speaking
Mouth breathingAdenoids, allergies or a blocked nose change tongue and jaw posture
Skeletal patternExcess vertical growth of the jaws; often runs in families
Jaw joint problemsSome joint conditions can change the bite later in life

In children, habits are the most common cause, and treatment is much easier if it's caught early. Stopping thumb sucking, exercises to retrain tongue posture and, if needed, a tongue-guard appliance are used. If the child breathes through the mouth, assessment together with an ENT doctor is important. This is why a first orthodontic check at age 7 is recommended; see early orthodontics for children.

• Clear aligners: Can work in some mild to moderate open bites caused by the teeth (clear aligners and braces).
  • Fixed braces: Give more predictable results for complex tooth movements; supported by mini-screws when needed.
  • Orthodontics with jaw surgery: For a marked skeletal open bite, orthodontics is planned together with jaw surgery, and the patient is also referred to a maxillofacial surgeon.

If habits such as tongue thrust continue, an open bite can relapse after treatment, so the retention phase is especially important (retainers after orthodontics). Adult orthodontics is covered in adult orthodontics.

In short

The key question with an open bite is whether the gap comes from the teeth or the jaws; the treatment plan depends on that distinction.

At the examination we look at the bite, tongue and lip movements and photos, plus X-rays and an intraoral scan if needed. We present the options with timing and cost in a written plan. Dent32 is at Barış Mah., Ginza Lavinya, E-5 Yanyolu No:30 D:179, 34520 Beylikdüzü, Istanbul; to book, call +90 555 011 33 68 or write to us.

faq.q: My lower teeth don't touch my upper teeth. Is that bone loss?
faq.a: Usually not; it is generally a bite problem caused by the position of the teeth or jaws. However, teeth drifting because of advanced gum disease can also create gaps. An examination and X-ray tell the difference.

faq.q: Does an open bite correct itself?
faq.a: In young children it can if the habit stops early. In adults it usually doesn't.

faq.q: Can it be treated with clear aligners?
faq.a: In some cases caused by the teeth, yes. For marked skeletal open bites, aligners alone may not be enough.

title: Soft tissue grafts for receding gums: pink aesthetics in Beylikdüzü
desc: Receding gums cause sensitivity and long-looking teeth. What are connective tissue and free gingival grafts, who are they for and what is recovery like? Pink aesthetics and periodontal plastic surgery at Dent32.
seoTitle: Soft tissue grafts for receding gums | Dent32
seoDesc: Receding gums cause sensitivity and long-looking teeth. Connective tissue and free gingival grafts: who they're for and what recovery is like.
lead: A beautiful smile isn't only about the teeth; the level, thickness and colour of the gums matter too. Dentists call this "pink aesthetics". Where the gums have receded, a small piece of tissue, usually taken from the palate (a graft), can thicken the gum and partly or fully cover the exposed root. Periodontal plastic surgery and pink aesthetics are among Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's areas of interest.

sections.html:
• A hard toothbrush, or brushing hard with a sideways scrubbing motion.
  • Gum disease and tartar.
  • Naturally thin gums.
  • Teeth positioned towards the outside of the bone, or orthodontic movement.
  • Teeth grinding, lip or tongue piercings, smoking.

We describe the signs of recession and first-line treatment in bleeding and receding gums.

MethodHow it's doneWhat for
Connective tissue graftConnective tissue from the palate is placed under the gum at the receded siteCovering the root, adding thickness in the smile zone
Free gingival graftSurface tissue from the palate is stitched directly onto the receded siteCreating a band of firm gum, especially at the lower front teeth
Tunnel and advancement techniquesThe gum is prepared as a tunnel with no or minimal incisions and moved with the graftRoot coverage on several teeth, faster healing
Tissue substitutesA collagen-based material is used instead of tissue from the palateAvoiding a second wound in the palate in suitable cases

• Teeth with progressing recession, root sensitivity or wear.
  • People unhappy with long, uneven-looking gums when they smile.
  • Thin gums that need strengthening before orthodontics, crowns or implants.

Active gum inflammation is treated first. Smoking worsens healing and results. For smiles where the gums sit too low, see gummy smile treatment.

The procedure is done under local anaesthetic. In the following days there may be tenderness, especially at the palate where tissue was taken; painkillers and cold compresses are usually enough. Soft, lukewarm food is best at first, and the treated area isn't brushed but cleaned with the mouthwash you're given. Stitches usually come out within one to two weeks, and the tissue takes a few months to reach its final form.

In short

A graft is the only way to regain lost gum; to stop recession, the cause has to be dealt with first.

At Dent32 we measure and record gum recession and explain its cause and the treatment options in a written plan. For our gum treatments see gum treatment in Beylikdüzü. Dent32 is at Barış Mah., Ginza Lavinya, E-5 Yanyolu No:30 D:179, 34520 Beylikdüzü, Istanbul; to book, call +90 555 011 33 68 or write to us.

faq.q: Do receded gums grow back on their own?
faq.a: No. Recession can be stopped, but lost gum doesn't regrow; surgical methods such as grafting are needed to cover the root.

faq.q: Is a gum graft painful?
faq.a: You won't feel pain during the procedure thanks to local anaesthetic. Afterwards there may be a few days of tenderness, especially at the palate.

faq.q: Does all gum recession need a graft?
faq.a: No. For mild recession that isn't progressing or causing problems, correcting brushing technique and regular check-ups may be enough.

title: Precision attachment dentures: a partial denture with no visible clasps
desc: What is a precision attachment partial denture? How a partial denture holds without visible metal clasps, how it compares with a conventional partial denture and implants, how to look after it and who it suits. Denture planning at Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: Precision attachment dentures with no visible clasps | Dent32
seoDesc: What is a precision attachment denture? How a partial denture holds with no visible clasps, how it compares with implants, and its upkeep.
lead: Conventional partial dentures grip the remaining teeth with metal clasps, which can show, especially when you smile. With a precision attachment denture, retention comes from small male and female connectors hidden inside crowns on the supporting teeth, so the denture clicks into place without a visible clasp. Precision attachment dentures are among the prosthetic options in Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's areas of interest.

sections.html:
1. The teeth next to the gap are prepared for crowns.
  2. One part of the attachment is built into the side of the crowns, where it can't be seen.
  3. The matching part sits inside the denture; when the denture is put in, the two parts lock together.
  4. The patient can take the denture out for cleaning and put it back in.

sections.h: Clasp denture, precision attachment denture and implants
sections.html:
TopicClasp partial denturePrecision attachment dentureImplants
AppearanceMetal clasp may showAttachment not visibleLike natural teeth
Supporting teethNot cut, or only minimally preparedCrownedNeighbouring teeth untouched
Removable?RemovableRemovable, firmer fitFixed
SurgeryNot neededNot neededNeeded

We also compare the options in types of dentures, implant or bridge? and implant-supported dentures.

• People missing back teeth who still have their front teeth and don't want visible clasps.
  • People who can't have implants because of general health or bone, or who prefer not to.
  • People whose supporting teeth are sound and already need crowns.

The supporting teeth need good gum and bone support; otherwise the attachment puts too much load on them. Denture options in later life are covered in dental care for older adults.

• Take the denture out and brush it every day, and clean the supporting teeth and the attachment area separately.
  • The plastic or metal retention parts inside the attachment loosen over time; they are replaced at check-ups to restore a firm fit.
  • Crowned supporting teeth should be checked regularly for decay and gum health.
In short

A precision attachment denture comes close to the comfort of fixed teeth without surgery; its success depends on the health of the supporting teeth.

At Dent32 we present denture options after an examination and X-rays, with their pros, limits and cost, in a written plan. Dent32 is at Barış Mah., Ginza Lavinya, E-5 Yanyolu No:30 D:179, 34520 Beylikdüzü, Istanbul; to book, call +90 555 011 33 68 or write to us.

faq.q: Is a precision attachment denture fixed?
faq.a: No, it is removable and taken out for cleaning. But it fits more firmly than a clasp denture and the attachment can't be seen.

faq.q: Do the supporting teeth have to be crowned?
faq.a: Usually yes; the attachment is built into the crown. That is why the condition of the supporting teeth is the most important part of the plan.

faq.q: Can attachments be used with implants?
faq.a: Yes. Similar attachment systems are used in removable dentures on implants, with retention coming from the implants.

title: Gum pockets and bone loss: pocket reduction and tissue regeneration
desc: What is a gum pocket and how many millimetres is normal? Treating deep pockets: scaling and root planing, flap surgery, guided tissue regeneration and bone grafts. Gum treatment at Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: Gum pockets and bone loss: treatment options | Dent32
seoDesc: How deep is a normal gum pocket? Treating deep pockets with scaling and root planing, flap surgery, tissue regeneration and bone grafts.
lead: There is naturally a small groove between each tooth and the gum. As gum disease progresses this groove deepens into a "pocket", where plaque and tartar collect beyond the reach of a toothbrush. Periodontal treatments that reduce pocket depth and, in suitable cases, regain lost bone are among Dr. Hüseyin Aşçı's areas of interest.

sections.h: What does pocket depth tell you?
sections.html:
Pocket depth is measured at several points around each tooth with a thin probe marked in millimetres (a periodontal probe). Whether the gum bleeds during measurement is also recorded.

DepthGeneral meaning
1–3 mmA healthy gum groove
4–5 mmEarly to moderate gum disease
6 mm or moreAdvanced disease, bone loss likely

These figures are a general guide; diagnosis is made by assessing measurements, bleeding and X-rays together.

Treatment starts with removing tartar below the gum and smoothing the root surfaces (root planing), together with coaching on the right home care. A few weeks later the pockets are measured again; many mild and moderate pockets shrink at this stage. More: gum treatment in Beylikdüzü.

• Flap surgery: The gum is lifted so the root surfaces can be cleaned under direct vision, and pocket depth is reduced.
  • Guided tissue regeneration: A membrane is placed over the area of bone loss to keep space for bone and the tissues that hold the tooth to regrow, instead of gum tissue.
  • Bone graft: In suitably shaped bone defects, the space is filled with graft material to support regeneration.

The success of regenerative treatment depends on the shape of the bone loss: vertical defects with surrounding walls respond better. Not all bone loss can be regained.

• Smoking: speeds up the disease and reduces the response to treatment.
  • Uncontrolled diabetes (dental care for people with chronic conditions).
  • Family tendency and stress.
  • Irregular check-ups and poor oral hygiene.

We discuss the link between gum disease and general health in "Oral health is a mirror of general health".

Even after gum disease has been treated, regular follow-up is needed. Maintenance visits, usually every three to four months, repeat the pocket measurements and cleaning. Keeping to this routine makes a marked difference to how long teeth last.

In short

A deep pocket is where your toothbrush can't reach; the answer is to bring it back to a cleanable depth and keep it there.
