faq.q: Do gum pockets close on their own?
faq.a: Shallow pockets caused by mild inflammation can improve with cleaning and good home care. Deep pockets need professional treatment; they don't close on their own.

faq.q: Can my loose tooth be saved?
faq.a: It depends on how much bone has been lost and in what pattern. An examination and X-rays show the tooth's outlook; some teeth can be kept for many years with treatment.

faq.q: Is pocket treatment painful?
faq.a: Procedures are done under local anaesthetic. There may be some tenderness for a few days afterwards.

title: Sterilisation and hygiene at a dental clinic: what to look for and what to ask
desc: How can you tell if a dental clinic sterilises properly? Autoclaves, sealed instrument pouches, single-use items, surface disinfection and waterlines. What to look for and ask about hygiene when choosing a clinic in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: Sterilisation and hygiene at a dental clinic | Dent32
seoDesc: How can you tell a dental clinic sterilises properly? Autoclaves, sealed instrument pouches, single-use items, surface disinfection and what to ask.
lead: Dental instruments come into contact with blood and saliva, so infection control is one of a dental clinic's most basic responsibilities. Hygiene standards aren't always visible from the outside, but there are signs patients can watch for and questions they can ask. In this post we follow an instrument through sterilisation and explain what to look out for at a clinic.

sections.html:
1. Used instruments are taken to a separate area away from the treatment room.
  2. They are cleaned first to remove blood and tissue, usually in an ultrasonic cleaner.
  3. They are dried and packed into sterilisation pouches.
  4. They are sterilised in an autoclave, using pressurised steam.
  5. The pouch is marked with the sterilisation date and stored sealed.
  6. The pouch is opened in front of the patient.

• Gloves are changed for every patient, and during treatment if contaminated.
  • Anaesthetic needles, saliva ejectors and some burs and tips are single use.
  • Patient bibs, cups and surface covers are replaced for every patient.

sections.h: Surfaces, the dental chair and waterlines
sections.html: Between patients, contact surfaces such as the chair, light handle and tray are disinfected or covered with single-use barrier film. The dental unit's waterlines need regular disinfection to prevent biofilm, and suction systems are cleaned daily.

sections.h: What you can look for and ask about
sections.html:
• Are the instruments in sealed pouches, and is the pouch opened in front of you?
  • Do the dentist and assistant wear gloves and masks, and put on fresh gloves?
  • Are the treatment room and waiting area clean and tidy?
  • When you ask how sterilisation is done, do you get a clear answer?

Other things to look for when choosing a clinic are in choosing between dental clinics in Beylikdüzü.

In short

A good clinic isn't bothered by questions about sterilisation; it's happy to explain how it's done.

At Dent32 instruments are stored sterilised in sealed pouches that are opened in front of the patient, and single-use items are replaced for every patient. You're welcome to ask anything about sterilisation at your examination. faq.q: Is there a risk of catching hepatitis or HIV at the dentist?
faq.a: When standard sterilisation and infection-control rules are followed, the risk is extremely low.

faq.q: What is an autoclave?
faq.a: A device that sterilises instruments with pressurised steam at high temperature; dental clinics use it for metal instruments.

faq.q: Should I mention a chronic illness or infection?
faq.a: Yes. This information is needed to plan treatment safely. Infection-control measures, meanwhile, are applied in the same way for every patient.

desc: Choosing a dentist for the whole family in Beylikdüzü: what children, teenagers, pregnant women and older relatives need, booking back-to-back appointments and keeping records in one place. Dent32 in Beylikdüzü is open every day including weekends.

lead: A family dentist is a clinic that follows the oral health of everyone in the household over the years. Going to one dental clinic in Beylikdüzü as a family makes it easier to combine appointments, helps children grow up without fear and makes it easier to spot inherited tendencies such as crowding, gum disease or a tendency to decay early.

sections.h: Why one dental clinic for the whole family?
sections.html:
• Records in one place: X-rays, fillings and crowns, medication and allergy information all stay in the same file. Years later, if a tooth causes trouble, seeing its history makes diagnosis easier.
  • Family tendencies: Jaw shape, tooth alignment and susceptibility to gum disease can run in families. A dentist who knows about a parent's problem looks for the same signs in a child sooner.
  • Shared appointments: Grouping check-ups on the same day saves time, especially for working parents. Weekend appointments help here.
  • Trust for children: A child who sees a parent being examined calmly gets used to the room and the faces more easily.

Family memberMain needsCheck-up interval (general advice)

Intervals vary from person to person; they may be shorter if you have gum disease or frequent decay. See our posts on the dental care for children in Beylikdüzü, dental treatment during pregnancy and dental care for older adults.

sections.h: Habits the whole family can share at home
sections.html:
1. Brush twice a day for at least two minutes with fluoride toothpaste; an adult finishes brushing for young children.
  2. Nothing but water after the evening brush.
  3. Have sugary and acidic drinks with meals rather than spread through the day.
  4. Adults and teenagers use floss or interdental brushes.
  5. Replace toothbrushes every 3 months or after an illness.

Read our guide to brushing properly together as a family.

In short

The real benefit of a family dentist is continuity: the same team sees changes over the years and catches problems while they're small.

faq.q: Can we book appointments for the whole family together?
faq.a: Yes. Consecutive appointments can be planned on the same day. Tell us in advance how many people are coming and what each person's concern is.

faq.q: When should I bring my child for the first time?
faq.a: After the first tooth appears and by around the age of one. The early visit is more about getting to know each other and advising parents than treatment.

faq.q: If gum disease runs in the family, are the children at risk too?
faq.a: Genetics and shared habits can both play a role. If there's a family history of tooth loss or receding gums, tell your dentist.

title: Just moved to Beylikdüzü? Changing dentists: records, X-rays and unfinished treatment
desc: A guide for people moving to Beylikdüzü: which records to ask your old clinic for, how unfinished implant, root canal and orthodontic treatment continues, and what happens at the first visit to a new clinic.
seoTitle: Moved to Beylikdüzü? Changing your dentist | Dent32
seoDesc: Moved to Beylikdüzü? Which records to request from your old clinic, how unfinished implant, root canal or orthodontic treatment continues.
lead: When you move to a new area you may need to change dentists too. If you've moved to Beylikdüzü and getting to your old clinic is difficult, the most important thing is to take your records with you and, if you have unfinished treatment, to find out the details. That way your new dentist can carry on where things left off instead of starting again.

sections.h: Which records should you ask your old clinic for?
sections.html:
• X-rays: Your panoramic X-ray, recent small (periapical) X-rays and any CT scan. Digital copies can be sent by email or on a USB stick.
  • Treatment summary: What was done to which tooth: fillings, root canals, crowns, extractions.
  • Implant details: The implant brand, system, diameter and length, and when it was placed. This is essential when the crown is made or a part needs replacing.
  • Orthodontic records: Starting records, photos and, for clear aligners, which stage you are at.
  • Health information: Medication, allergies and long-term conditions.

As a patient you have the right to ask for a copy of your own health records. Some treatment records may also appear on e-Nabız, Turkey's personal health record system, but X-ray images often don't, so asking the clinic directly is the most reliable route.

Unfinished treatmentWhat the new clinic looks at
An implant still healingThe implant brand and size; compatible parts are used for the crown
Teeth with temporary crownsThe condition of the teeth and whether a new impression is needed
A root canal that's been startedWhether the temporary filling is intact; medication shouldn't stay in the canal for too long
Clear aligner treatmentAligner brand and stage; some systems allow transfer to another dentist
BracesBracket system and treatment plan; treatment continues using the records
In short

Don't leave a started root canal or a temporary crown for months. Temporary materials aren't designed to last; the risk of leakage and fracture rises.

sections.h: Your first appointment at a new clinic

faq.q: Does my old clinic have to give me my X-rays?
faq.a: Patients can ask for copies of their own health records. Most clinics share digital X-rays easily by email; a written request speeds things up.

faq.q: I don't know my implant brand. Is that a problem?
faq.a: Ask your old clinic first. If they can't be reached, the system can often be identified from an X-ray and examination, but finding compatible parts can be harder.

faq.q: Can I continue my clear aligner treatment in Beylikdüzü?
faq.a: In many cases, yes. Once the aligner brand and stage are known, a transfer can be planned. Some systems may need new scans and a new plan.

title: A second opinion on dental treatment in Beylikdüzü: how to assess the plan you've been given
desc: When should you get a second opinion on dental treatment? Questions to ask, warning signs, and what to bring to a second-opinion appointment in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: A second opinion on dental treatment in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
lead: If you've been given a plan with lots of crowns, implants or extractions, or the proposed treatment doesn't feel right, getting a second opinion is completely normal. A good dentist won't mind. Before visiting another dental clinic in Beylikdüzü, gather the plan and X-rays you've been given; it makes comparison much easier.

sections.h: When does a second opinion make sense?
sections.html:
• You've been advised to crown many teeth that look healthy or don't hurt.
  • You've been told to extract a tooth that might be saveable.
  • Implants for the whole mouth or extensive smile design have been planned.
  • You were asked to decide without being shown the findings or having the X-ray explained.
  • There are large, unexplained differences in price.

A simple filling or scale and polish rarely needs a second opinion. What matters most are irreversible procedures: cutting teeth down, extracting them or placing implants.

sections.h: Questions to ask about a plan
sections.html:
1. What exactly is wrong with this tooth? Can you show me on the X-ray?
  2. What happens if I don't have the treatment, or postpone it?
  3. Is there a less invasive option (for example a filling or bonding instead of a crown)?
  4. Which treatment is urgent and which can wait?
  5. What materials will be used and what are the warranty terms?
  6. How long will it take in total, and how many visits?
In short

Different dentists can propose different but valid plans for the same mouth. What matters is that the reasoning behind each option is explained clearly.

• Pressure to start the same day, or a "today only" price.
  • Crowns proposed for all the front teeth without a clear reason.
  • No written plan or price.
  • Your questions being brushed aside.

We compare crowns and veneers in types of dental crowns, and implants and bridges in implant or bridge. For judging clinics, see how to read dental clinic reviews.

sections.h: What to bring to a second-opinion appointment
sections.html:
• The written treatment plan and quote you were given.
  • Your panoramic X-ray and any CT scan (digital copies).
  • A list of your medication.
  • Brief notes on when your symptoms started.

At Dent32 we show second-opinion patients the findings on screen and explain our assessment side by side with the plan they've been given. Where you continue treatment is entirely your decision.

faq.q: Is getting a second opinion disrespectful to my first dentist?
faq.a: No. A second opinion is common and sensible, especially for extensive and irreversible treatment.

faq.q: Will new X-rays be taken for a second opinion?
faq.a: If the X-rays you bring are recent and clear, they're usually enough. Old or incomplete images may need updating.

faq.q: If the two plans are very different, which should I trust?
faq.a: Ask both dentists for their reasoning and alternatives. The plan that's explained most clearly and involves fewer irreversible steps is often a safe starting point.

title: Same-day dental treatment in Beylikdüzü: what can be done in one visit, and what has to wait?
desc: Which dental treatments are finished in one visit and why do others need several? Realistic times for fillings, cleaning, extractions, bonding, root canals, zirconia crowns and implants. Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: Same-day dental treatment in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: Which dental treatments finish in one visit and why others need several? Realistic times for fillings, extractions, root canals, crowns and implants.
lead: Fillings, scale and polish, simple extractions, bonding and in-clinic whitening are usually finished in a single visit. Zirconia crowns and veneers need a few appointments because of the lab stage, and implants need a few months for the bone to heal. For busy patients in Beylikdüzü, the best approach is a plan that groups treatments sensibly.

sections.h: Treatments usually finished in one visit
sections.html:
TreatmentApproximate timeNote
Examination and X-ray20–40 minA written plan can be given the same day
Scale and polish30–60 minDeep cleaning for gum disease may be split over several visits
White (composite) filling20–60 min per toothSeveral fillings can be done in one visit
Simple extraction20–40 minImpacted wisdom teeth take longer

Emergency pain treatment30–60 minThe cause of pain is dealt with, then permanent treatment is planned

Times vary with the person and the tooth. We describe fillings in detail in dental fillings in Beylikdüzü.

sections.h: Why do some treatments need more than one visit?
sections.html:
• Root canal treatment: Often finished in one visit when there's no infection. With an abscess or severe infection, medication is placed in the canal and a second visit follows.
  • Zirconia and e.max crowns: The tooth is prepared, an impression is taken and the crown is made in a lab. With a try-in and fitting, this usually takes 2–3 appointments over a few days to two weeks.
  • Veneers: The trial (mock-up) stage directly affects the result, so it shouldn't be rushed.
  • Implants: The implant is placed in one visit, but bonding with the bone takes a few months. In some suitable cases a temporary tooth can be fitted the same day; see same-day implants.
  • Orthodontics: Tooth movement is a biological process that takes months.

sections.h: How we group treatment to keep visits to a minimum
sections.html:
For busy patients we combine treatments in the same area into one visit: for example, several fillings in the same jaw together, or an extraction and a clean on the same day. Long sessions aren't right for everyone; we plan with fatigue and jaw discomfort in mind.

In short

When you see "smile in a day" offers, ask exactly which part is really finished in a day and which part is temporary.

faq.q: Can a root canal be done in one visit?
faq.a: Often yes, if there's no infection or swelling and the canals allow it. With an abscess it's usually split over two visits.

faq.q: Can a zirconia crown be fitted the same day?
faq.a: Usually not, because it's made in a lab. A temporary crown is fitted in between; the whole process usually takes a few days to two weeks.

faq.q: Can several fillings be done in one visit?
faq.a: Yes, especially fillings in the same jaw, with a single anaesthetic. The total time and the condition of the teeth decide.

title: Dental X-rays and CT scans in Beylikdüzü: when are panoramic, periapical and 3D images needed?
desc: Types of dental X-ray: periapical, bitewing, panoramic and dental CT (CBCT). When each is used, how much radiation, and whether X-rays are taken during pregnancy. Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: Dental X-rays and CT scans in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: Periapical, bitewing and panoramic X-rays and dental CT: when each is used, how much radiation, and X-rays during pregnancy.
lead: Dental X-rays are used to see decay that isn't visible, infection at the root tip and how much bone there is. Small periapical films look at one tooth, a panoramic image shows the whole mouth, and a dental CT (CBCT) shows the bone in three dimensions. Dental X-ray doses are very low, but they should still only be taken when needed.

sections.h: Types of dental X-ray and what they're for
sections.html:
ImageWhat it showsWhen it's used
Periapical (small film)One or two teeth down to the root tipA painful tooth, root canal treatment, root-tip infection
BitewingThe contact surfaces of the back teethEarly detection of decay between teeth
PanoramicBoth jaws, all the teeth, the jaw jointsFirst visit, wisdom teeth, general assessment
Dental CT (CBCT)Bone width and height, nerve and sinus positionImplant planning, impacted teeth, complex root canal cases

Not every check-up needs an X-ray. How often you need one depends on your age, decay risk and symptoms, and is decided by the dentist.

sections.h: How much radiation? Is it safe?
sections.html:
Dental X-rays are among the lowest-dose medical images. Roughly, a periapical film is a few microsieverts and a panoramic image is usually around 10–25 microsieverts. With dental CT, the dose depends on the size of the area scanned and usually ranges from tens to a few hundred microsieverts. For comparison, a person receives on average around 2,000–3,000 microsieverts a year from natural background radiation.

  • Images aren't taken unless needed; bring any recent X-rays you have.
  • CT is only requested when a two-dimensional image isn't enough.
  • In children, the area and frequency are kept even more limited.

sections.h: Can dental X-rays be taken during pregnancy?
sections.html: Routine check-up X-rays can wait until after birth. But an X-ray needed to diagnose pain, an abscess or an emergency can be taken with appropriate protection; an untreated infection is also a risk for mother and baby. See dental treatment during pregnancy for more.

sections.h: Why is a CT scan important before implants?
sections.html: A panoramic image gives an idea of bone height but doesn't show its width. A CT scan shows bone width, the nerve canal in the lower jaw and the sinus in the upper jaw in three dimensions. This lets the implant's length and angle be planned more safely and shows in advance whether a bone graft or sinus lift is needed.

At Dent32 we show you the images taken or brought in on screen during the examination and explain the findings. We'll tell you at your appointment which image is needed and where it will be taken. Our dental clinic in Beylikdüzü is at Barış Mah., Ginza Lavinya, E-5 Yanyolu No:30 D:179, 34520 Beylikdüzü, Istanbul; to book, call +90 555 011 33 68.

faq.q: How often should dental X-rays be taken?
faq.a: There's no fixed rule. Adults with low decay risk may only need bitewings every few years; with higher risk or symptoms, more often.

faq.q: What's the difference between a dental CT and a panoramic X-ray?
faq.a: A panoramic is a two-dimensional overview. A CT shows the bone in three dimensions and is used for implant planning and impacted teeth.

faq.q: Can I bring an X-ray taken elsewhere?
faq.a: Yes. If it's recent and clear, a new one may not be needed. A digital copy is easiest.

title: Same-day implants in Beylikdüzü: who is suitable for an implant at extraction and immediate loading?
desc: What are same-day implants? Conditions, benefits and risks of placing an implant at the extraction visit (immediate implant) and fitting a temporary tooth the same day (immediate loading). Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: Same-day implants in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: What are same-day implants? Conditions, benefits and risks of an implant at the extraction visit and a temporary tooth the same day.
lead: "Same-day implant" can mean two different things: placing the implant in the same visit the tooth is extracted, and fitting a temporary tooth on the implant the same day. Both are possible in patients with suitable bone, healthy gums and infection under control. The permanent tooth is made after the bone has healed, usually within a few months.

sections.html:
ApproachWhat's doneWhen is the permanent tooth fitted?
Conventional (delayed) implantTooth extracted, site heals for 2–3 months, then the implant is placed2–4 months after the implant
Immediate implantImplant placed in the same visit as the extractionAfter the bone has bonded
Immediate loadingA temporary tooth is fitted on the implant the same day or within a few daysThe temporary is used for a few months, then replaced

With immediate loading, the temporary tooth is usually adjusted to keep it out of heavy biting; for the first weeks you don't bite hard things with it. We describe fixed temporary teeth for a whole jaw in All-on-Four in Beylikdüzü.

sections.h: Who is it suitable for, and who not?
sections.html:
• May be suitable: Enough bone around the tooth to be extracted, no active widespread infection, and good initial stability (primary stability) when the implant is placed.
  • Waiting may be better: A large abscess or bone loss, uncontrolled diabetes, heavy smoking or severe grinding, or thin gum and bone at a front tooth that raises the aesthetic risk.

The decision is made after an examination and a dental CT scan, which shows bone width and the position of the nerve and sinus; see dental X-rays and CT scans.

In short

A same-day implant isn't "better" for everyone. In the right case it shortens treatment; in the wrong case it can raise the risk of failure.

• Fewer surgical procedures may be needed.
  • Less time without a tooth, especially at the front.
  • May help preserve bone and gum shape at the extraction site.
  • The temporary tooth must not be loaded in the first weeks; a soft diet is advised.
  • Smoking lowers the chance of success because it impairs bone healing.

For the first days, see our implant aftercare post.

sections.h: Implant planning at Dent32 in Beylikdüzü
sections.html:
At Dent32 implant treatment starts with an examination, a CT scan and a written plan; we tell you whether an immediate implant suits you after this assessment. We describe the whole process step by step in dental implants in Beylikdüzü.

Our dental clinic in Beylikdüzü is at Barış Mah., Ginza Lavinya, E-5 Yanyolu No:30 D:179, 34520 Beylikdüzü, Istanbul. Call +90 555 011 33 68 or write to us through the contact page.

faq.q: Is a permanent tooth fitted on the same day as a same-day implant?
faq.a: No, the tooth fitted the same day is temporary. The permanent tooth is made from an impression after the implant has bonded with the bone.

faq.q: Can an implant be placed immediately where an infected tooth was?
faq.a: Sometimes, with limited infection that can be cleaned well. With a large abscess or bone loss, waiting for healing is safer.

faq.q: Is the success rate lower with immediate loading?
faq.a: In well-selected cases, results similar to the conventional approach have been reported. Patient selection and protecting the temporary tooth in the first weeks are key.

title: Bone grafts and sinus lifts in Beylikdüzü: not enough bone — can I still have an implant?
desc: Implants when bone is lacking: bone grafts, open and closed sinus lifts, healing times and aftercare. CT-based planning at Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: Bone grafts and sinus lifts in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
lead: When a tooth has been missing for a long time, the jawbone gradually becomes thinner and shorter. Even with too little bone, an implant is often still possible; but adding bone graft material before or during the implant visit, or raising the sinus floor in the upper jaw (a sinus lift), may be needed. A dental CT shows which.

sections.html:
• After an extraction there is no root to stimulate the bone; noticeable loss of bone width can happen in the first months.
  • Advanced gum disease (periodontitis) destroys the bone around teeth.
  • Removable dentures worn for years press on the bone underneath.
  • When upper back teeth are lost, the sinus can expand downwards.

So if you're considering an implant after an extraction, it helps not to wait too long, or to preserve the socket with graft material at the time of extraction.

sections.h: Bone grafts, sinus lifts and other techniques
sections.html:
TechniqueWhen?Healing
Socket preservationRight after extraction, with a future implant in mindAbout 3–4 months
Bone graft at the implant visitSmall bone defectsAs long as the implant takes to bond
Closed (crestal) sinus liftModerately reduced bone height in the upper back jawUsually in the same visit as the implant
Open (lateral) sinus liftVery little bone heightOften 4–9 months
Block graft or ridge expansionLarge, advanced bone lossSeveral months

Graft material can be synthetic, animal-derived (usually bovine) or human-derived. The choice depends on the size of the defect. We explain the techniques in detail in bone graft and sinus lift.

1. Don't blow your nose hard for the first two weeks; sneeze with your mouth open.
  2. Don't drink through a straw, and don't smoke.
  3. Ask your dentist before flying, diving or heavy exercise.
  4. Take prescribed medication as directed.
  5. A little nosebleed can happen in the first days; call the clinic if it gets worse.
In short

Bone grafting makes treatment longer but gives the implant a solid base for a long life. Placing an implant in inadequate bone to save time can be risky.

At Dent32 we assess the bone with a CT scan and explain in a written plan whether grafting is needed and how much longer treatment will take. For the whole implant process, see dental implants in Beylikdüzü.

faq.q: Can the body reject bone graft material?
faq.a: Graft materials are processed and biocompatible; over time they are replaced by or fuse with the patient's own bone. Infection and smoking can affect success.

faq.q: Is a sinus lift painful?
faq.a: It's done under local anaesthetic. There may be swelling and tenderness for a few days afterwards, usually controlled with painkillers.

faq.q: When is the implant placed after a bone graft?
faq.a: With small grafts, in the same visit; with large grafts, usually 4–9 months later. A follow-up CT decides the exact timing.

title: E.max crowns in Beylikdüzü: glass ceramic for a natural look on front teeth
desc: E.max (lithium disilicate) crowns in Beylikdüzü: how they differ from zirconia, which teeth they suit, how many visits they take and what affects how long they last. Crown planning at Dent32.
seoTitle: E.max crowns in Beylikdüzü: natural-looking front teeth | Dent32
seoDesc: E.max (lithium disilicate) crowns: how they differ from zirconia, which teeth they suit, how many visits they take and how long they last.
lead: E.max is a glass ceramic called lithium disilicate that lets a lot of light through. Because it looks very close to a natural tooth, it's used especially on front teeth as crowns, veneers and inlays/onlays. On back teeth and for bridges, the stronger zirconia is usually preferred.

sections.html:
FeatureE.maxZirconia
AppearanceVery natural, translucentGood; newer zirconias are more translucent
StrengthSufficient for single teethHigher; preferred for bridges
Typical useFront teeth, veneers, single crownsBack teeth, bridges, on implants
Tooth reductionVery little as a veneerUsually more for a crown

The material is chosen according to the tooth's position, biting forces, any grinding habit and its colour. See what are e.max crowns and zirconia crowns in Beylikdüzü for more.

sections.h: How many visits does an e.max crown take?
sections.html:
1. Examination, photos and shade selection; a trial smile (mock-up) if needed.
  2. Tooth preparation and impression; a temporary crown is fitted.
  3. Manufacture in the lab.
  4. Try-in: shade, shape and bite are checked.
  5. Permanent bonding with a special adhesive.

This usually takes 2–3 appointments over a few days to two weeks. On front teeth, the try-in stage may take longer depending on aesthetic expectations.

sections.h: What affects how long e.max lasts?
sections.html:
• Night-time grinding: a protective night guard is recommended if you grind.
  • Not biting hard objects (pens, nails, ice, seeds).
  • Healthy gums and regular professional cleaning.
  • Check-ups every 6–12 months.
In short

Well-cared-for e.max crowns can last many years. The risk of fracture is highest in people who grind and don't wear a night guard.

At Dent32 we plan crowns and veneers with photos and, where needed, a trial, and choose the material together based on what your tooth needs. You can see examples in our gallery.

faq.q: Can e.max be used on back teeth?
faq.a: For single crowns and onlays, yes. For bridges and in patients who grind heavily, zirconia is often safer.

faq.q: Do e.max crowns change colour?
faq.a: The ceramic surface doesn't stain from tea, coffee or smoking. What changes over time is usually the colour of the surrounding natural teeth and gums.

faq.q: Is e.max the same as a veneer?
faq.a: A veneer is a type of restoration; e.max is a material. Many veneers are made from e.max.

title: Bonding and closing gaps between teeth in Beylikdüzü: cosmetic fixes without drilling
desc: Can a gap between front teeth (diastema), a chipped corner or a shape problem be fixed with bonding in one visit? Bonding vs veneers vs orthodontics. Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: Bonding and closing gaps between teeth in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: Can a gap between front teeth, a chipped corner or a shape problem be fixed with bonding in one visit? Bonding vs veneers vs orthodontics.
lead: Bonding means adding tooth-coloured composite to the tooth surface layer by layer and shaping it. The tooth usually isn't drilled and it's done in one visit. It's a good option for small gaps between front teeth, chipped corners and small shape problems; for bigger colour and alignment problems, veneers or orthodontics may be better.

sections.h: Why do gaps between teeth (diastema) happen?
sections.html:
• Teeth that are small relative to the jaw.
  • A thick, low-attached frenum (the band linking the upper lip to the gum).
  • Teeth drifting because of gum disease.
  • Habits like tongue thrusting or thumb sucking.
  • Missing or small lateral incisors.

If the gap is caused by gum disease, gum treatment comes first; otherwise a closed gap can open again.

OptionSuitable forTimeTooth reduction
BondingSmall gaps, chipped corners, reshapingOne visitUsually none
VeneersGap + colour + shape to be changed together2–3 appointmentsLittle
OrthodonticsLarge or multiple gaps, bite problemsMonthsNone

We compare bonding and veneers in what is dental bonding and veneers in Beylikdüzü.

sections.h: How long does bonding last, and how do you look after it?
sections.html:
Composite is softer than ceramic; over time its colour may darken slightly and small chips may appear at the edges. It's often used for years and can be refreshed with polishing or small additions when needed.

  • Don't bite hard things (seeds, nails, pens) with your front teeth.
  • Coffee, tea and smoking can affect the colour; regular polishing helps.
  • Wear a night guard if you grind.
In short

Bonding preserves the tooth and is reversible. If you want veneers or orthodontics later, those options stay open.

faq.q: How many visits does it take to close a gap with bonding?

faq.q: Does bonding hurt?

faq.q: Can I whiten my teeth after bonding?
faq.a: Composite doesn't whiten. If you're considering whitening, do it first, then bonding.

title: Teeth grinding, night guards and jaw joint pain in Beylikdüzü: symptoms and treatment

title: Chipped or broken front tooth in Beylikdüzü: keep the fragment — same-day cosmetic repair is possible
desc: Broken a front tooth or chipped a corner? How to store the fragment, when it's urgent, and options from bonding and reattaching the fragment to veneers and root canal treatment. Dent32 in Beylikdüzü, open at weekends too.
seoTitle: Chipped or broken front tooth in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: Broken a front tooth? How to store the fragment, when it's urgent, and options from bonding and reattachment to veneers and root canals.
lead: If you break a front tooth and can find the broken piece, keep it in milk or saline and see a dentist as soon as possible. Small fractures are often repaired with bonding the same day; where suitable, the fragment itself can be bonded back. If the break reaches the nerve or the tooth has moved, waiting puts the tooth at risk.

sections.html:
1. Rinse your mouth with lukewarm water; if it's bleeding, press with clean gauze.
  2. Find the broken piece and keep it in milk, saline or saliva so it doesn't dry out.
  3. If there's swelling, apply something cold to the outside of the cheek.
  4. If a sharp edge cuts your tongue or lip, cover it with sugar-free gum or dental wax.
  5. If the whole tooth has come out, hold it by the crown, not the root, and come to the clinic immediately.

We cover what to do for children after an injury in knocked-out or broken tooth and general fractures and cracks in broken or cracked tooth.

Fracture typeSignsPossible treatment

In short

Even without pain, a broken tooth should be checked with an X-ray; the blow may have affected the root or nerve, and symptoms can appear weeks later.

A front tooth repaired with bonding can look good for years. If the fracture is large or the tooth has discoloured, a veneer or e.max crown may give a longer-lasting result later. Darkening of an injured tooth over time can mean the nerve has been affected, so follow-up matters.

faq.q: Can a broken piece of tooth be stuck back on?
faq.a: Often yes, if the piece is intact and has been stored properly. Keeping it in milk or saline and bringing it the same day improves the chances.

faq.q: If a broken front tooth doesn't hurt, can it wait?
faq.a: It can wait a short time but shouldn't be put off. Exposed dentine is sensitive and prone to decay, and the blow may have damaged the nerve.

faq.q: How long does a front tooth repaired with bonding last?
faq.a: It can last for years depending on care and biting habits. It can be renewed, or replaced with a veneer, when needed.

title: Early orthodontics for children in Beylikdüzü: the age-7 check and removable appliances

By then the first permanent molars and front teeth have started to come through, and problems with jaw growth can be spotted early. Not every child needs early treatment, but for some problems using growth can prevent longer and more complex treatment later.

sections.html: Around seven, baby and permanent teeth are in the mouth together (mixed dentition). The dentist assesses how the jaws fit together, whether there's room for the permanent teeth and the effect of any habits. Most of the time, only monitoring is recommended; if treatment is needed, the best timing is decided.

Early orthodontics is often done in two phases: the jaw is guided during growth, then, once the permanent teeth are in, a second shorter treatment if needed.
Most permanent teeth are in by around age 12–13. Treatment can then be done with braces or, in suitable cases, clear aligners. We compare the options in orthodontics in Beylikdüzü.

faq.q: Are braces fitted on a 7-year-old?

faq.q: Does thumb sucking permanently damage the teeth?
faq.a: If it stops before the permanent teeth come through, the problem often corrects itself. If it goes on for a long time, an open bite and a narrow jaw can develop.

faq.q: Does early treatment remove the need for braces later?
faq.a: For some children it can; for others it shortens the second phase. It depends on the problem and on growth.

title: Diabetes, blood pressure, blood thinners: safe dental treatment in Beylikdüzü for people with long-term conditions
desc: Dental treatment with diabetes, high blood pressure, heart disease, blood thinners or osteoporosis medication: what to tell your dentist, whether medication should be stopped, and precautions before extractions and implants. Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: Diabetes, blood pressure, blood thinners | Dent32
seoDesc: Dental treatment with diabetes, high blood pressure, heart disease, blood thinners or osteoporosis drugs: what to tell your dentist.
lead: Someone with a long-term condition can have dental treatment; what matters is that the condition is under control and the dentist knows what medication you take. Don't stop blood thinners or other medication on your own. When needed, the dentist plans treatment together with the doctor who looks after you.

sections.html:
• All the medication you take and the doses (a photo of the boxes works too).
  • Blood thinners: warfarin, newer anticoagulants, aspirin and similar.
  • Medication for osteoporosis or cancer treatment (bisphosphonates, denosumab).
  • Heart valve disease, a prosthetic heart valve or a history of endocarditis.
  • Diabetes and your latest HbA1c result.
  • Allergies, especially to medicines and latex.
In short

If medication needs stopping or changing, the doctor who prescribed it decides. Most simple procedures can be done with suitable precautions without stopping medication.

sections.h: What to watch for, by condition
sections.html:
ConditionIn dental treatment
DiabetesIf well controlled, treatment and implants are possible; with poor control, gum disease and healing problems increase. Eat your usual meal before the appointment.
High blood pressureTake your medication as usual; if blood pressure is very high, planned procedures may be postponed.
Blood thinnersFor simple extractions and gum procedures, local bleeding control is usually enough without stopping the medication; with warfarin, a recent INR is checked.
Osteoporosis medicationEspecially with intravenous drugs, extractions and implants need careful planning because of jawbone complications.

PregnancyCovered in a separate guide: dental treatment during pregnancy.

sections.h: The two-way link between diabetes and gum disease
sections.html: Poorly controlled diabetes speeds up gum disease, and untreated gum inflammation can make blood sugar harder to control. That's why regular professional cleaning and gum treatment are especially important for people with diabetes. If you have diabetes and are considering implants, see who can get dental implants.

Many blood pressure, antidepressant, allergy and diuretic medicines reduce saliva. Dry mouth raises the risk of decay and of sore spots under dentures. Drinking water often, sugar-free gum, fluoride toothpaste and regular check-ups help. We also cover this in dental care for older adults.

sections.h: Patients with long-term conditions at Dent32

faq.q: I take blood thinners. Should I stop before an extraction?
faq.a: Don't stop on your own. Most simple extractions can be done without stopping; if needed, the dentist talks to the doctor who prescribed the medication.

faq.q: Can people with diabetes have implants?
faq.a: Implants can be successful when blood sugar is well controlled. With poor control, getting blood sugar in order first is recommended.

faq.q: Should I take my blood pressure medication on the day of my appointment?
faq.a: Yes, unless told otherwise, take your medication as usual. Your blood pressure may be measured at the appointment.

title: Getting your smile ready for the wedding: how many months ahead should you start in Beylikdüzü?

title: Root canal retreatment in Beylikdüzü: if a root-filled tooth hurts again, does it have to come out?

seoTitle: Root canal retreatment in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: Why does a root-filled tooth hurt, swell or develop a gum boil? Root canal retreatment, apicoectomy and when extraction is needed.
lead: A tooth that's had root canal treatment can hurt again years later, swell, or develop a pimple-like bump on the gum (a sinus tract). That doesn't always mean it has to be extracted. In suitable cases the old root filling can be removed and the treatment redone, or minor surgery can be done at the root tip. The decision is made with an X-ray and, if needed, a CT scan.

sections.h: Why does a root-filled tooth cause problems again?
sections.html:
• An extra canal that wasn't found or fully cleaned the first time.
  • Bacteria leaking into the canal around the edge of a filling or crown.
  • The permanent crown not being made for a long time.
  • A crack or fracture in the root.
  • New decay reaching the root canal.

We explain root canal treatment in general in root canal treatment in Beylikdüzü.

OptionWhat's doneWhen it's suitable
Root canal retreatmentThe old root filling is removed and the canals are cleaned and filled againIf the canals can be reached and the root is sound

In short

Keeping your own tooth is usually the first choice. But trying to save a tooth with a cracked root can waste time and money, so an accurate diagnosis matters.

sections.h: Symptoms that mean you should come in

Sometimes a problem in a root-filled tooth gives no symptoms and shows up as a shadow at the root tip on a routine X-ray. Whether to monitor or treat then depends on the size of the lesion and whether it's changing.

faq.q: Can root canal treatment be done a second time?
faq.a: Yes, retreatment is a common procedure. Success depends on the root being sound and the canals being reachable.

faq.q: Is retreatment painful?
faq.a: It's done under local anaesthetic. The tooth may be tender to bite on for a few days afterwards.

faq.q: Retreatment or an implant?
faq.a: If the root is sound and there's enough healthy tooth left, saving your own tooth is usually tried first. With a root fracture, an implant may be more predictable.

title: One missing tooth in Beylikdüzü: implant, bridge or adhesive bridge?
desc: Which option is right for a single missing tooth? Implant, conventional bridge, adhesive (Maryland) bridge and partial denture compared, and the risks of leaving the gap. Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: One missing tooth in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: Which option suits a single missing tooth? Implant, conventional bridge, adhesive bridge and partial denture compared, and the risks of a gap.
lead: The most common options for a single missing tooth are an implant, a conventional bridge and, especially at the front, an adhesive (Maryland) bridge. If the neighbouring teeth are healthy and the bone is suitable, an implant replaces the tooth without touching them. Leaving the gap for years can make neighbouring teeth tilt and the opposing tooth over-erupt.

sections.h: What happens if you leave the gap?
sections.html:
• Neighbouring teeth tilt into the gap and food collects between them.
  • The opposing tooth grows into the space; the bite can change.
  • Bone in the gap shrinks over time; a bone graft may be needed for an implant later.
  • At the front, appearance and speech are affected; at the back, chewing.

A single missing back tooth may seem unimportant at first, but these changes develop slowly over the years.

OptionEffect on neighbouring teethTimeNote
ImplantUntouchedUsually 2–6 monthsNeeds enough bone; long-lasting

Adhesive (Maryland) bridgeMinimal work on the back of a neighbouring tooth1–2 weeksMostly front teeth and younger patients

We compare two of these in detail in implant or bridge. What happens when bone is lacking is in bone grafts and sinus lifts.

• Healthy neighbours, enough bone: An implant is usually the first choice.
  • Neighbours need large fillings or crowns: A conventional bridge protects these teeth too.
  • Young patient, missing front tooth, still growing: An adhesive bridge or temporary solution until growth ends; an implant later.
  • Surgery not wanted for health or budget reasons: A bridge or partial denture.
In short

The best option isn't simply the "most expensive" or "fastest"; it's the one that suits your neighbouring teeth and long-term plan.

faq.q: Is an implant or a bridge better for one tooth?

faq.q: How long does a Maryland bridge last?

faq.q: How long can I wait before getting an implant for a missing tooth?
faq.a: Waiting too long increases bone loss. An implant is usually planned within 2–3 months of extraction, and in suitable cases on the same day.

title: Haven't seen a dentist for years? Step-by-step full mouth rehabilitation in Beylikdüzü
desc: A comprehensive treatment plan for patients with multiple cavities, missing teeth and gum problems: emergencies, disease control, re-evaluation, permanent treatment and maintenance. Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: Haven't seen a dentist for years? | Dent32
seoDesc: Haven't seen a dentist for years? A step-by-step plan: emergencies, disease control, re-evaluation, permanent treatment and maintenance.
lead: Someone who hasn't seen a dentist for a long time may have cavities, broken teeth, gaps and gum problems all at once. Rather than doing everything at the same time, a step-by-step plan is the healthiest approach: first pain and infection, then getting the disease under control, and finally permanent and cosmetic treatment. That keeps both the budget and the timeline manageable.

sections.h: The stages of full mouth rehabilitation
sections.html:
StageAimExamples
1. UrgentRelieve pain and infectionDraining an abscess, starting a root canal on a painful tooth, removing a tooth that can't be saved

In short

Crowns and implants placed without treating gum disease don't last as long. That's why stage 2 shouldn't be skipped.

• Pain and swelling always come first.

The plan can be split into stages to fit your budget; at the end of each stage your oral health is better than before. We explain what affects cost in dental treatment prices in Beylikdüzü.

sections.h: Don't be embarrassed — you won't be judged

Treatment depends on the cause and depth of the spot, and good results are often possible without drilling.

faq.q: Do white spots on teeth go away on their own?
faq.a: Early decay spots can stop with good care and fluoride, and some become less visible over time. Developmental spots don't go away on their own.

faq.q: Can white spots left after braces be treated?
faq.a: Yes. Remineralisation is tried first; for permanent spots, resin infiltration or bonding can work well.

faq.q: Does whitening get rid of white spots?
faq.a: On its own, usually not; but by lightening the overall shade it can make them less noticeable.

seoDesc: Options for crooked and crowded teeth: clear aligners, braces, veneers, bonding and reshaping. Which suits which case, and the risks.
lead: The most tooth-friendly way to straighten crooked and crowded teeth is orthodontics, and nearly invisible clear aligners can now be used for it. For very mild irregularities, bonding or small reshaping may be enough. "Straightening without braces" using veneers only suits selected cases; if it needs heavy tooth reduction, it can harm the teeth in the long run.

faq.q: Can crowded teeth be fixed with veneers?

faq.q: My lower front teeth have become crowded with age. Why?
faq.a: Teeth can slowly move forward and inward in adulthood. A short course of clear aligners followed by a retainer is often enough.

title: Dental polyclinic, clinic or private practice in Beylikdüzü: what's the difference?

seoTitle: Dental polyclinic, clinic or private practice in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: Dental polyclinic, clinic or private practice: number of dentists, appointment flexibility, treatment plans and the questions to ask.
lead: In Turkey, a muayenehane (private practice) is opened by a single dentist in their own name, while a poliklinik (polyclinic) can be opened as a company and usually has several dentists working together. In everyday language, people call all of them a "dental clinic". When choosing in Beylikdüzü, what matters is not the sign above the door but the dental team, the written plan you get after the examination and the follow-up after treatment.

sections.h: Private practice, polyclinic and centre: what's the difference?
sections.html:
Private dental facilities in Turkey are regulated and licensed by the Ministry of Health. Roughly, the main types are:

TypeWho opens it?What it means in practice
Muayenehane (private practice)A dentist, in their own nameUsually one dentist; you often see the same dentist every time
Poliklinik (polyclinic)One or more dentists; can be a companySeveral dentists and chairs; appointment times can be more flexible
Oral and dental health centreA larger team and more dental chairsMany dentists, usually longer opening hours
HospitalAn in-patient facilityProcedures under general anaesthetic and extensive surgery

"Dental clinic" is the everyday word used for all of these. So searches for "dental clinic in Beylikdüzü" and "dental polyclinic in Beylikdüzü" usually show the same places. You can see a facility's licence type on the licence displayed at the entrance or simply ask.

In short

The word on the sign doesn't decide the quality of your treatment. Who will treat you, whether you get a written plan and who you can reach if something goes wrong matter far more.

sections.h: Advantages of a clinic with several dentists
sections.html:

  • Flexible appointments: With several dentists and treatment rooms, weekend and evening appointments are easier to find.
  • Continuity: If one dentist is away, your records and treatment plan are still at the clinic when you come in with an urgent problem.
  • Second opinion: In complex cases, another dentist in the same clinic can give an opinion.

Single-dentist practices have strengths too: you see the same dentist each time and the relationship is more personal. The right choice depends on what you need.

seoTitle: On-call and emergency dentist in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: Emergency dentists in Beylikdüzü: the night and holiday rota at state facilities, what's truly urgent, when to call 112, and weekend care.
lead: With toothache that starts in the middle of the night, the first step is to tell pain apart from a spreading infection. If you have fast-growing facial swelling, difficulty swallowing or breathing, or a high fever, call 112 or go to a hospital emergency department straight away. Otherwise, controlling the pain until morning and seeing a dentist the same day is usually enough; Dent32 in Beylikdüzü is open every day, including weekends.

sections.html:
SituationWhat to do
Swelling spreading below the eye or into the neck, difficulty swallowing or breathingDon't wait: call 112 or go to A&E

Lost filling or crown, no painAppointment within a few days
Sharp edge on a broken toothCover it with wax or sugar-free gum and book within a few days
In short

An infection from a tooth spreading into the face and neck is rare but serious. With rapidly growing swelling and difficulty breathing, go straight to an emergency department, not a dental clinic.

sections.h: How does the on-call dentist system work?
sections.html:
In Istanbul, emergency dental care at night and on public holidays is mainly provided through the on-call rota of oral and dental health hospitals and centres run by the Ministry of Health. Because the facility on call can change from night to night, the most reliable way to find out is to check with the Istanbul Provincial Health Directorate or call the Ministry of Health helpline, ALO 184.

On-call services usually provide first aid that brings pain and infection under control: opening the tooth to relieve pressure, draining an abscess, stopping bleeding or, if needed, an extraction. Permanent treatments such as root canals, crowns or implants are planned at later appointments.

sections.h: What you can do at home until morning
sections.html:
• Painkillers: Take a painkiller your doctor has previously said is suitable for you, at the dose on the pack. Don't put aspirin on the tooth or gum; it burns the tissue.
  • Cold compress: A cold compress on the cheek for 15–20 minutes at a time can reduce swelling and pain. Avoid heat.
  • Keep your head up: Raising your head with an extra pillow when lying down can ease throbbing.
  • Warm salt water: For gum-related pain, gently rinsing with warm salt water can help.
  • Antibiotics: Don't start leftover antibiotics on your own. Antibiotics don't cure most toothache; we explain why in our article on antibiotics and toothache.

You'll find what to do for each type of pain in our night and weekend toothache guide.

title: Tooth extraction and impacted wisdom teeth in Beylikdüzü: procedure, pain and recovery
desc: Tooth extraction and impacted wisdom tooth removal in Beylikdüzü: when a tooth needs to come out, how it's done, whether it hurts, blood thinners, recovery time and replacing the missing tooth.
seoTitle: Tooth extraction and impacted wisdom teeth in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: Tooth extraction and impacted wisdom teeth: when a tooth must come out, how it's done, whether it hurts, blood thinners and recovery time.
lead: A tooth extraction is the removal, under local anaesthetic, of a tooth that is too damaged to save or is causing problems. A routine extraction usually takes a few minutes; an impacted wisdom tooth usually takes 20–45 minutes. You won't feel pain during the procedure; mild pain and swelling for the first 2–3 days is normal. At Dent32, we only decide on extraction after discussing options for saving the tooth.

sections.h: When does a tooth need to be extracted?
sections.html:
We aim to keep teeth wherever possible; decay or infection can often be treated with root canal treatment and a crown. Extraction usually comes up when:

  • The root is fractured or decay has reached the root and the tooth can't be restored
  • Advanced gum disease has destroyed the bone support and the tooth is loose
  • An impacted wisdom tooth causes repeated infection, decay in the neighbouring tooth or a cyst
  • Space is needed for orthodontic treatment
  • Infection persists despite treatment
In short

Before an extraction, we discuss options for saving the tooth and how the gap will be filled afterwards. If a gap is left for a long time, neighbouring teeth can drift and the bone shrinks.

sections.h: How is a tooth extracted, and does it hurt?
sections.html:
First, an X-ray is used to assess the root shape and surrounding structures. Local anaesthetic numbs the area completely; you may feel pressure but no pain. In a routine extraction, the tooth is gently loosened from its socket with special instruments and removed.

For impacted teeth or teeth with curved roots, the gum is opened, the tooth may be divided into pieces to remove it, and the area is closed with stitches. When patients tell us "I didn't feel a thing", it's mostly down to giving enough anaesthetic at the right time.

Type of extractionTypical timeRecovery
Routine (erupted tooth)A few minutes to 15 minutesSoft tissue about 1–2 weeks
Impacted or partially impacted wisdom toothAbout 20–45 minutesSwelling peaks at 2–3 days and clearly settles within a week
Multiple extractionsDepends on the number of teethPlanned together with dentures or implants

• Blood thinners: Don't stop aspirin, warfarin or newer anticoagulants on your own. The decision is made with the doctor who prescribed them; most extractions can be done safely while continuing the medicine, with local bleeding control.
  • Diabetes: If your blood sugar is under control, extraction is done as normal. Poorly controlled diabetes can delay healing.
  • Osteoporosis medicines: If you have taken bisphosphonates or similar medicines, always tell us; the plan is adjusted accordingly.
  • Pregnancy: Non-urgent extractions are usually postponed to the second trimester. Details: dental treatment during pregnancy.

• Bite on the gauze pad for 30–45 minutes.
  • For the first 24 hours, don't spit, use a straw or rinse; the clot could be dislodged.
  • Don't eat until the numbness wears off, and choose lukewarm, soft foods on the first day.
  • Smoking delays healing and raises the risk of dry socket; avoid it for at least 2–3 days.
  • Severe pain that gets worse after day 2–3, with a bad smell, may be dry socket; contact us.

For full details, see our after tooth extraction guide and our wisdom tooth article.

A gap can be filled with an implant, a bridge or a removable denture. In suitable cases an implant can be placed in the same session as the extraction. We compare the options in implant or bridge?.

faq.q: Does a tooth extraction hurt?
faq.a: Local anaesthetic means you won't feel pain during the procedure, although you may feel pressure. There is some mild pain once it wears off, usually controlled with painkillers.

faq.q: When can I go back to work after an extraction?
faq.a: After a routine extraction, most people go back to work the same day or the next day. After an impacted wisdom tooth, resting for 1–2 days is a good idea.

faq.q: Can an abscessed tooth be extracted?
faq.a: Usually yes; sometimes the infection needs to be controlled first. The decision is made at the examination.

faq.q: When are the stitches removed?
faq.a: If dissolving stitches weren't used, usually after 7–10 days.

faq.q: Do you do extractions at the weekend?
faq.a: Dent32 is open at weekends too, and extractions can be done in suitable cases. Let us know on WhatsApp before you come.

title: All-on-Four and full-arch implants in Beylikdüzü: the road to fixed teeth
desc: All-on-Four and full-arch implants in Beylikdüzü: who fixed teeth on four implants suit, whether same-day temporary teeth are possible, how many months it takes, how it compares with dentures, and aftercare. Dent32 Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: All-on-Four and full-arch implants in Beylikdüzü | Dent32
seoDesc: All-on-Four and full-arch implants: who fixed teeth on four implants suit, same-day temporaries, how many months it takes and aftercare.
lead: All-on-Four means placing four implants in a toothless jaw and fixing a one-piece row of teeth on top. If bone and general health allow, temporary fixed teeth can be fitted within a few days of implant surgery, often the same day; the final teeth are made after the implants have fused with the bone, usually within 3–6 months. At Dent32, the decision is made after a CT scan to assess the bone.

sections.h: What is All-on-Four, and how is it different from dentures?
sections.html:
A conventional full denture rests on the palate or gums and can move in the mouth. With All-on-Four, the prosthesis is screwed onto four implants; you don't take it in and out but clean it as you would your teeth. The back implants are usually placed at an angle, which keeps them away from the sinus and nerve and can reduce the need for bone grafting.

Conventional full dentureAll-on-Four
StabilityRemovable, may need adhesiveFixed, screwed onto implants
PalateUpper denture covers the palatePalate stays open, so taste and speech feel more natural
ChewingHard foods are difficultCloser to natural chewing
BoneBone continues to shrink over timeImplants load the bone and slow shrinkage
CareTaken out and cleanedCleaned in the mouth with a brush, interdental brush and water flosser

• People who have lost all their teeth, or whose remaining teeth can't be saved
  • Denture wearers who want fixed teeth
  • People whose general health allows minor surgery
  • People with enough bone to support at least four implants

Uncontrolled diabetes, heavy smoking and some bone medicines increase the risk; these are assessed in detail beforehand. See who can get dental implants. If bone is very limited, more than four implants (All-on-Six) or bone augmentation may be needed: bone grafts and sinus lifts.

1. Examination and 3D CT scan: Bone volume and distance to the sinus and nerve are measured.
  2. Digital planning: Implant positions and the length, colour and smile line of the teeth are planned.
  3. Surgery: Any extractions and placement of the four implants are done under local anaesthetic, usually in one session.
  4. Temporary fixed teeth: If the implants are stable enough at placement, a temporary row of teeth is fitted within a few days, often the same day.
  5. Integration: A soft diet for about 3–6 months.
  6. Final prosthesis: Impressions, try-in and fitting of the final row of teeth.
In short

Same-day temporary teeth aren't suitable for everyone. Whether the implants hold firmly enough at placement (primary stability) decides it.

We explain the general idea in our All-on-Four article and implant timelines in how long do implants take.

Food can collect under a fixed prosthesis. You need to brush twice a day, clean under the prosthesis with an interdental brush or water flosser, and have professional check-ups at least once or twice a year. At check-ups we monitor screw tightness, the gums and the bone around the implants. Inflammation around implants (peri-implantitis) is the main long-term threat; see how long do dental implants last for details.

At the examination we look at your bone, your expectations and your budget together, and set out All-on-Four, implant-retained removable dentures and conventional dentures side by side. The main cost factors are the implant brand, the prosthesis material (acrylic, zirconia or metal-reinforced) and any additional surgery. See implant-supported dentures and implant cost factors.

Dent32 is a dental clinic in Barış, Beylikdüzü, on the E-5 service road, open every day including weekends. If you have a panoramic X-ray, send it on WhatsApp (+90 555 011 33 68) and the dentist can give preliminary advice.

faq.q: How many days does All-on-Four take?
faq.a: Temporary fixed teeth are usually fitted within a few days of surgery. The final prosthesis is made after the implants fuse with the bone, usually within 3–6 months.

faq.q: Is All-on-Four painful?
faq.a: Surgery is done under local anaesthetic. There is swelling and tenderness for a few days afterwards, controlled with painkillers.

faq.q: Can I have All-on-Four if I don't have much bone?
faq.a: Angling the back implants often reduces the need for bone grafting. If bone is very insufficient, extra procedures or a different plan may be needed.

faq.q: Can both jaws be done at the same time?
faq.a: Yes. If your general health allows, both jaws can be planned in the same session or a short time apart.

faq.q: How long does a fixed prosthesis last?
faq.a: With good care, the implants can last for many years. The prosthetic teeth may wear over time and need replacing.

title: Hollywood smile in Beylikdüzü: can a bright white smile still look natural?
desc: What is a Hollywood smile, how is it done with veneers or zirconia, how many teeth are covered, are teeth filed down, and what makes it look natural? Planning and try-in at Dent32 in Beylikdüzü.
seoTitle: Hollywood smile in Beylikdüzü: can it look natural? | Dent32
seoDesc: What is a Hollywood smile, how is it done with veneers or zirconia, how many teeth are covered, and what keeps it looking natural?
lead: A Hollywood smile means renewing all the teeth that show when you smile (usually 8–10 upper teeth, sometimes 16–20 including the lower jaw) at the same time with veneers or zirconia crowns, for a bright, even look. Whether it looks natural depends on choosing the colour, length and shape of the teeth to suit your face. At Dent32, you see the result in your mouth with a temporary mock-up before anything permanent is done.

sections.html:
Hollywood smile isn't a medical term but a description of a look: white, symmetrical, gap-free and even teeth. It's usually achieved with laminate veneers or zirconia crowns, sometimes planned together with whitening, gum contouring and orthodontics.

The real question isn't "how many teeth?" but which teeth show when you smile. With a broad smile, the premolars show too; covering only the front six teeth would leave a colour difference.

In short

A good Hollywood smile looks like healthy teeth, not "done" teeth. That comes from the right shade, tooth length that suits your facial proportions and a touch of natural translucency.

Laminate (porcelain) veneersZirconia crowns
Tooth reductionMinimal; mostly the front surface onlyMore; the tooth is reduced on all sides
Suitable forSound teeth that are slightly crowded or discolouredTeeth with large fillings, root canals or fractures
AppearanceHigh translucency, very naturalNatural; slightly more opaque next to very translucent teeth
DurabilityMany years in the right caseMore durable on back teeth and under heavy chewing

Many Hollywood smile plans combine veneers on the front teeth with zirconia on heavily filled or root-treated teeth. We compare the materials in types of dental crowns.

sections.h: Choosing the shade: "whitest" isn't always best
sections.html:
The lightest shades on the crown shade guide (often called "bleach" or BL shades) don't occur in natural teeth. A very light shade can look artificial on some faces, so it should be judged together with skin tone, the whites of the eyes and gum colour. We choose shades in daylight, on photos and on the mock-up.

If some teeth won't be covered (the lower teeth, for example), teeth whitening is done first and the veneers are matched to the new shade.

1. Photos, video and an intraoral scan; talking through your expectations
  2. Digital design: tooth length, shape and smile line
  3. Try-in with a temporary mock-up in your mouth; reviewing it in the mirror and on photos
  4. After approval, tooth preparation, impressions and temporary teeth
  5. Try-in and bonding of the final veneers or crowns
  6. Bite check and, if needed, a night guard

The process is usually completed over a few appointments within 2–3 weeks. For detailed planning, see smile design in Beylikdüzü.

• Unnecessary tooth reduction: Heavily reducing healthy teeth just for whiteness is irreversible. Plans aiming for the least possible reduction should be preferred.
  • Clenching: In people who clench at night, veneers and crowns can chip; a night guard is recommended.
  • Gum health: Gum inflammation should be treated first; otherwise colour and recession problems appear at the margins.
  • Maintenance: Veneers don't decay, but the tooth and gum underneath can; regular check-ups are needed.

For a consultation, WhatsApp or call +90 555 011 33 68. Dent32 is a dental clinic on the E-5 service road in Beylikdüzü, open every day including weekends.

faq.q: How many teeth is a Hollywood smile?
faq.a: It depends on which teeth show when you smile; usually 8–10 upper teeth, or 16–20 teeth including the lower jaw if needed.

faq.q: Does a Hollywood smile ruin your teeth?
faq.a: Well-planned veneers with minimal tooth reduction don't harm the teeth. Heavily reducing healthy teeth unnecessarily, however, is an irreversible loss.

faq.q: How long does a Hollywood smile take?
faq.a: Including planning and try-in, it's usually completed over a few appointments within 2–3 weeks.

faq.q: How long does a Hollywood smile last?
faq.a: Depending on care and habits, veneers and zirconia crowns can last for many years. Clenching, biting hard objects and smoking shorten their life.

faq.q: Can I see the result in advance?
faq.a: Yes. The design is tried in your mouth with a temporary mock-up before any permanent work begins.

title: Dental fillings in Beylikdüzü: how long does a white filling take, and when can you eat?
desc: Dental fillings in Beylikdüzü: how a white (composite) filling is done, how long it takes, whether it hurts, when you can eat afterwards, how long fillings last and when an inlay or onlay is needed. Dent32.
seoTitle: Dental fillings in Beylikdüzü: time, pain and aftercare | Dent32
seoDesc: How a white (composite) filling is done, how long it takes, whether it hurts, when you can eat, how long it lasts and when an onlay is needed.
lead: A filling replaces the cavity left after decay is removed with a tooth-coloured material. A single white (composite) filling usually takes 20–45 minutes and sets instantly under a curing light, so you only need to wait for the numbness to wear off before eating. Caught early, decay can be treated with a filling before it needs a root canal or crown.

sections.h: When do you need a filling?
sections.html:
Decay starts in the enamel (the outer layer) and, if untreated, moves into the dentine and then the nerve. Decay in the enamel and dentine is treated with a filling; once it reaches the nerve, root canal treatment is needed. We explain the stages in signs of tooth decay.

  • A brief twinge with sweet or cold things
  • Brown or black spots or a visible hole in the tooth
  • Food getting stuck between teeth
  • A chipped tooth edge or an old filling with an open margin
  • Decay between teeth seen on a check-up X-ray before it causes symptoms
In short

Decay found before it hurts ends with a small, inexpensive filling. That's why a check-up every 6–12 months is the way to catch fillings at the earliest stage.

sections.h: How is a white filling done?
sections.html:
1. If needed, the area is numbed with local anaesthetic.
  2. The decay is removed while sound tooth is preserved.
  3. The tooth surface is prepared with a special gel and bonding agent.
  4. The composite is matched to your tooth colour and built up in layers, each hardened with a blue curing light.
  5. The filling is shaped, the bite is checked and it's polished.
Filling typeTypical timeNote
Small front or back filling20–30 minutesUsually one visit
Large filling covering several surfaces30–60 minutesAn inlay or onlay may be considered depending on biting load
Several teeth in one sessionDepends on the number of teethTeeth on the same side can be done under one anaesthetic

sections.h: When can I eat after a filling?
sections.html:
A composite filling sets instantly under the light, so there's no need to wait for the filling itself. If you had anaesthetic, though, don't eat until the numbness wears off (usually 1–3 hours); you could bite your cheek or lip without noticing. The same applies to hot drinks.

Mild sensitivity to cold for the first few days is normal. If the filling feels "high" when you bite, or sensitivity lasts more than a week, pop in for a quick adjustment. If a filling falls out, see what to do if a filling falls out.

sections.h: How long does a filling last?
sections.html:
Composite fillings usually last many years, depending on care, size and habits. The main things that shorten their life are clenching, biting hard objects, frequent sugary snacks and new decay at the edge of the filling. For very large losses, a porcelain or composite inlay or onlay made in a laboratory is a more durable option.

If your amalgam (silver) fillings are sound, you don't have to replace them just for colour; if they're cracked or decayed, they can be replaced with white fillings. Details: what is a white filling.

At the examination we check all your teeth and, if needed, take X-rays to see decay between teeth. If you need several fillings, we put them in order of urgency and plan them to reduce your number of visits. Prices depend on the number of surfaces and the material, and are given in writing after the examination.
